27 visitor::visitor(const std::shared_ptr<yoi::moduleContext> &moduleContext,
28 const std::shared_ptr<yoi::IRModule> &irModule,
29 yoi::indexT moduleIndex)
30 : moduleContext(moduleContext), irModule(irModule), currentModuleIndex(moduleIndex) {}

32 std::shared_ptr<yoi::IRModule> visitor::visit() {
33 IRDebugInfo debugInfo{irModule->modulePath, 0, 0};
34 auto globInitializer = managedPtr(IRFunctionDefinition{
35 L"yoimiya_glob_initializer", {}, moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getNoneObjectType(), {}, {}, debugInfo});
36 irModule->functionTable.put(L"yoimiya_glob_initializer", globInitializer);
37 moduleContext->pushIRBuilder({moduleContext->getCompilerContext(), irModule, globInitializer});
38 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().setDebugInfo({irModule->modulePath, 0, 0});
39 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock());
40 visit(&moduleContext->getModuleAST());
41 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().retOp(true);
42 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().yield();
43 moduleContext->popIRBuilder();
44 return irModule;
45 }

53 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::basicLiterals *basicLiterals) {
54 switch (basicLiterals->node.kind) {
55 case yoi::lexer::token::tokenKind::integer: {
56 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().pushOp(
57 IR::Opcode::push_integer, {IROperand::operandType::integer, basicLiterals->node.basicVal.vInt});
58 break;
59 }
60 case yoi::lexer::token::tokenKind::decimal: {
61 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().pushOp(
62 IR::Opcode::push_decimal, {IROperand::operandType::decimal, basicLiterals->node.basicVal.vDeci});
63 break;
64 }
65 case yoi::lexer::token::tokenKind::string: {
66 auto literalIndex = irModule->stringLiteralPool.addStringLiteral(basicLiterals->node.strVal);
67 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().pushOp(IR::Opcode::push_string,
68 {IROperand::operandType::stringLiteral, literalIndex});
69 break;
70 }
71 case yoi::lexer::token::tokenKind::boolean: {
72 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().pushOp(
73 IR::Opcode::push_boolean, {IROperand::operandType::boolean, basicLiterals->node.basicVal.vBool});
74 break;
75 }
76 case yoi::lexer::token::tokenKind::character: {
77 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().pushOp(
78 IR::Opcode::push_character, {IROperand::operandType::character, basicLiterals->node.strVal[0]});
79 break;
80 }
81 case yoi::lexer::token::tokenKind::shortInt: {
82 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().pushOp(
83 IR::Opcode::push_short, {IROperand::operandType::shortInt, basicLiterals->node.basicVal.vShort});
84 break;
85 }
86 case yoi::lexer::token::tokenKind::unsignedInt: {
87 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().pushOp(
88 IR::Opcode::push_unsigned, {IROperand::operandType::unsignedInt, basicLiterals->node.basicVal.vUint});
89 break;
90 }
91 case yoi::lexer::token::tokenKind::kNull: {
92 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().pushOp(IR::Opcode::push_null, {});
93 break;
94 }
95 default: {
96 panic(basicLiterals->node.line, basicLiterals->node.col, "Unexpected basic literal type");
97 break;
98 }
99 }
100 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
101 }

103 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::identifier *identifier, bool isStoreOp) {
104 auto &id = identifier->node.strVal;
105 try {
106 auto index = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().irFuncDefinition()->getVariableTable().lookup(id);
107 auto valType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().irFuncDefinition()->getVariableTable().get(index);
108 if (isStoreOp) {
109 tryCastTo(valType);
110 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().storeOp(IR::Opcode::store_local,
111 {IROperand::operandType::localVar, yoi::indexT{index}});
112 } else {
113 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().loadOp(
114 IR::Opcode::load_local, {IROperand::operandType::localVar, yoi::indexT{index}}, valType);
115 }
116 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
117 } catch (std::out_of_range &e) {
118 // let it go, try to find it in global variables
119 }
120 try {
121 auto index = irModule->globalVariables.getIndex(id);
122 auto valType = irModule->globalVariables[index];
123 if (isStoreOp) {
124 tryCastTo(valType);
125 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().storeOp(IR::Opcode::store_global,
126 {IROperand::operandType::globalVar, yoi::indexT{index}});
127 } else {
128 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().loadOp(
129 IR::Opcode::load_global, {IROperand::operandType::globalVar, yoi::indexT{index}}, valType);
130 }
131 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
132 } catch (std::out_of_range &e) {
133 panic(identifier->node.line, identifier->node.col, "Undefined identifier: " + wstring2string(id));
134 }
135 }

137 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::primary *primary, bool isStoreOp) {
138 switch (primary->kind) {
139 case 0:
140 visit(primary->member, isStoreOp);
141 break;
142 case 1:
143 visit(primary->literals);
144 break;
145 case 2:
146 visit(primary->expr);
147 break;
148 case 3: {
149 visit(primary->typeId);
150 break;
151 }
152 case 4: {
153 visit(primary->dynCast);
154 break;
155 }
156 case 5: {
157 visit(primary->newExpr);
158 break;
159 }
160 case 6: {
161 auto lambdaStructIndex = createLambdaUnnamedStruct(primary->lambda);
162 auto [lambdaCallableIndex, callableInterface] = createCallableImplementationForLambda(irModule->structTable[lambdaStructIndex], lambdaStructIndex, currentModuleIndex);
163 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().newInterfaceOp(callableInterface.second, true, callableInterface.first);
164 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().constructInterfaceImplOp(lambdaCallableIndex);
165 break;
166 }
167 default: {
168 panic(primary->getLine(), primary->getColumn(), "Unexpected primary type");
169 }
170 }
171
172 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
173 }

175 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::abstractExpr *abstractExpr, bool isStoreOp) {
176 if (abstractExpr->rhs) {
177 yoi_assert(!isStoreOp, abstractExpr->getLine(), abstractExpr->getColumn(), "trying to apply store op on a boolean expression");
178 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().saveState();
179 visit(abstractExpr->lhs);
180 auto lhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
181 auto rhs = parseTypeSpec(abstractExpr->rhs);
182
183
184 if (abstractExpr->op.kind == lexer::token::tokenKind::kImpl) {
185 yoi_assert (rhs.type == IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject, abstractExpr->rhs->getLine(), abstractExpr->rhs->getColumn(), "RHS of 'impl' operator must be an interface type");
186 auto interfaceImplName = getInterfaceImplName({rhs.typeAffiliateModule, rhs.typeIndex}, lhs);
187 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().restoreState();
188 // push the boolean
189 if (moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(lhs->typeAffiliateModule)->interfaceImplementationTable.contains(interfaceImplName)) {
190 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().pushOp(IR::Opcode::push_boolean, {IROperand::operandType::boolean, IROperand::operandValue{true}});
191 } else {
192 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().pushOp(IR::Opcode::push_boolean, {IROperand::operandType::boolean, IROperand::operandValue{false}});
193 }
194 } else if (abstractExpr->op.kind == lexer::token::tokenKind::kInterfaceOf) {
195 yoi_assert(lhs->type == IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject, abstractExpr->lhs->getLine(), abstractExpr->lhs->getColumn(), "LHS of 'interfaceof' operator must be an interface type");
196 // cut off some possibilies here.
197 auto key = std::make_tuple(rhs.type, rhs.typeAffiliateModule, rhs.typeIndex);
198 auto &vec = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(lhs->typeAffiliateModule)->interfaceTable[lhs->typeIndex]->implementations;
199 if (std::find(vec.begin(), vec.end(), key) != vec.end()) {
200 // emit typeid op and emit interfaceof
201 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().discardState();
202 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().typeIdOp(managedPtr(rhs));
203 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().interfaceOfOp();
204 } else {
205 // push the boolean
206 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().restoreState();
207 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().pushOp(IR::Opcode::push_boolean, {IROperand::operandType::boolean, IROperand::operandValue{false}});
208
209 }
210 } else if (abstractExpr->op.kind == lexer::token::tokenKind::kAs) {
211 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().discardState();
212 auto typeSpec = managedPtr(rhs);
213 tryCastTo(typeSpec);
214 }
215 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
216 } else {
217 return visit(abstractExpr->lhs, isStoreOp);
218 }
219 }

221 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::uniqueExpr *uniqueExpr, bool isStoreOp) {
222 visit(uniqueExpr->lhs, isStoreOp);
223
224 switch (uniqueExpr->getOp().kind) {
225 case lexer::token::tokenKind::incrementSign: {
226 // TODO: add support for operator overloading
227 auto &lhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
228
229 if (lhs->isBasicType()) {
230 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().uniqueArithmeticOp(IR::Opcode::increment);
231 } else {
232 handleUnaryOperatorOverload(L"operator++");
233 }
234 break;
235 }
236 case lexer::token::tokenKind::decrementSign: {
237 // TODO: add support for operator overloading
238 auto &lhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
239 if (lhs->isBasicType()) {
240 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().uniqueArithmeticOp(IR::Opcode::decrement);
241 } else {
242 handleUnaryOperatorOverload(L"operator--");
243 }
244 break;
245 }
246 case lexer::token::tokenKind::binaryNot: {
247 // TODO: add support for operator overloading
248 auto &lhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
249 if (lhs->isBasicType()) {
250 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().uniqueArithmeticOp(IR::Opcode::bitwise_not);
251 } else {
252 handleUnaryOperatorOverload(L"operator~");
253 }
254 break;
255 }
256 case lexer::token::tokenKind::minus: {
257 auto &lhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
258 if (lhs->isBasicType()) {
259 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().uniqueArithmeticOp(IR::Opcode::negate);
260 } else {
261 handleUnaryOperatorOverload(L"operator-");
262 }
263 break;
264 }
265 case lexer::token::tokenKind::unknown: {
266 // means no op
267 break;
268 }
269 default: {
270 panic(uniqueExpr->getOp().line, uniqueExpr->getOp().col, "Unexpected unique expression operator");
271 }
272 }
273 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
274 }

276 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::leftExpr *leftExpr) {
277 if (leftExpr->hasRhs()) {
278 switch (leftExpr->getOp().kind) {
279 case lexer::token::tokenKind::assignSign: {
280 visit(leftExpr->rhs);
281 visit(leftExpr->lhs, true);
282 visit(leftExpr->lhs);
283 break;
284 }
285 case lexer::token::tokenKind::directAssignSign: {
286 auto lhsPos = visit(leftExpr->lhs);
287 auto rhsPos = visit(leftExpr->rhs);
288 auto lhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getLhsFromTempVarStack();
289 tryCastTo(lhs);
290 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().insert({IR::Opcode::direct_assign, {}, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo()});
291 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().popFromTempVarStack();
292 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().popFromTempVarStack();
293 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().pushTempVar(lhs);
294 break;
295 }
296 case lexer::token::tokenKind::additionAssignment: {
297 auto lhsPos = visit(leftExpr->lhs);
298 auto rhsPos = visit(leftExpr->rhs);
299 auto &lhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getLhsFromTempVarStack();
300 auto &rhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
301
302 if (lhs->isBasicType() && rhs->isBasicType()) {
303 tryCastTo(lhs);
304 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().arithmeticOp(IR::Opcode::add);
305 visit(leftExpr->lhs, true);
306 visit(leftExpr->lhs);
307 } else {
308 handleBinaryOperatorOverload(L"operator+=");
309 }
310 break;
311 }
312 case lexer::token::tokenKind::subtractionAssignment: {
313 auto lhsPos = visit(leftExpr->lhs);
314 auto rhsPos = visit(leftExpr->rhs);
315 auto &lhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getLhsFromTempVarStack();
316 auto &rhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
317 if (lhs->isBasicType() && rhs->isBasicType()) {
318 tryCastTo(lhs);
319 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().arithmeticOp(IR::Opcode::sub);
320 visit(leftExpr->lhs, true);
321 visit(leftExpr->lhs);
322 } else {
323 handleBinaryOperatorOverload(L"operator-=");
324 }
325 break;
326 }
327 case lexer::token::tokenKind::multiplicationAssignment: {
328 auto lhsPos = visit(leftExpr->lhs);
329 auto rhsPos = visit(leftExpr->rhs);
330 auto &lhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getLhsFromTempVarStack();
331 auto &rhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
332 if (lhs->isBasicType() && rhs->isBasicType()) {
333 tryCastTo(lhs);
334 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().arithmeticOp(IR::Opcode::mul);
335 visit(leftExpr->lhs, true);
336 visit(leftExpr->lhs);
337 } else {
338 handleBinaryOperatorOverload(L"operator*=");
339 }
340 break;
341 }
342 case lexer::token::tokenKind::divisionAssignment: {
343 auto lhsPos = visit(leftExpr->lhs);
344 auto rhsPos = visit(leftExpr->rhs);
345 auto &lhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getLhsFromTempVarStack();
346 auto &rhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
347 if (lhs->isBasicType() && rhs->isBasicType()) {
348 tryCastTo(lhs);
349 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().arithmeticOp(IR::Opcode::div);
350 visit(leftExpr->lhs, true);
351 visit(leftExpr->lhs);
352 } else {
353 handleBinaryOperatorOverload(L"operator/=");
354 }
355 break;
356 }
357 default: {
358 panic(leftExpr->getOp().line,
359 leftExpr->getOp().col,
360 "Unexpected left expression operator, received: " + wstring2string(leftExpr->getOp().strVal));
361 }
362 }
363 } else {
364 visit(leftExpr->lhs);
365 }
366
367 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
368 }

370 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::mulExpr *mulExpr) {
371 auto term = mulExpr->getTerms().begin();
372 auto op = mulExpr->getOp().begin();
373 auto lhsPos = visit(*term); // lhs
374 for (; op != mulExpr->getOp().end(); ++op) {
375 auto rhsPos = visit(*++term); // rhs
376 auto &lhsType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getLhsFromTempVarStack();
377 auto &rhsType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
378
379 if (lhsType->isBasicType() && rhsType->isBasicType()) {
380 switch (op->kind) {
381 case lexer::token::tokenKind::asterisk: emitBasicCastInBasicArithOpByLhsAndRhs(lhsPos, rhsPos); moduleContext->getIRBuilder().arithmeticOp(IR::Opcode::mul); break;
382 case lexer::token::tokenKind::slash: emitBasicCastInBasicArithOpByLhsAndRhs(lhsPos, rhsPos); moduleContext->getIRBuilder().arithmeticOp(IR::Opcode::div); break;
383 case lexer::token::tokenKind::percentSign: moduleContext->getIRBuilder().arithmeticOp(IR::Opcode::mod); break;
384 default: panic(op->line, op->col, "Unexpected multiplication expression operator");
385 }
386 } else {
387 switch (op->kind) {
388 case lexer::token::tokenKind::asterisk: handleBinaryOperatorOverload(L"operator*"); break;
389 case lexer::token::tokenKind::slash: handleBinaryOperatorOverload(L"operator/"); break;
390 case lexer::token::tokenKind::percentSign: handleBinaryOperatorOverload(L"operator%"); break;
391 default: panic(op->line, op->col, "Unexpected multiplication expression operator");
392 }
393 }
394
395 lhsPos = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
396 }
397 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
398 }

412 case lexer::token::tokenKind::minus: emitBasicCastInBasicArithOpByLhsAndRhs(lhsPos, rhsPos); moduleContext->getIRBuilder().arithmeticOp(IR::Opcode::sub); break;
413 default: panic(op->line, op->col, "Unexpected addition expression operator");

418 case lexer::token::tokenKind::minus: handleBinaryOperatorOverload(L"operator-"); break;
419 default: panic(op->line, op->col, "Unexpected addition expression operator");
420 }
421 }
422 lhsPos = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
423 }

427 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::shiftExpr *shiftExpr) {
428 auto term = shiftExpr->getTerms().begin();

431 for (; op != shiftExpr->getOp().end(); ++op) {

434 auto &rhsType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();

443 switch (op->kind) {
444 case lexer::token::tokenKind::binaryShiftLeft: handleBinaryOperatorOverload(L"operator<<"); break;
445 case lexer::token::tokenKind::binaryShiftRight: handleBinaryOperatorOverload(L"operator>>"); break;
446 default: panic(op->line, op->col, "Unexpected shift expression operator"); break;
447 }
448 }
449
450 }

461 auto rhsType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
462
463 if (lhsType->isBasicType() && rhsType->isBasicType()) {
464 switch (op->kind) {

469 default: panic(op->line, op->col, "Unexpected relational expression operator");

478 }
479 }
480 lhsPos = rhsPos;
481 }
482
483 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
484 }

489 auto lhsPos = visit(*term);

493 auto &rhsType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();

496 switch (op->kind) {

498 case lexer::token::tokenKind::notEqual: emitBasicCastInBasicArithOpByLhsAndRhs(lhsPos, rhsPos); moduleContext->getIRBuilder().arithmeticOp(IR::Opcode::not_equal); break;

501 } else {
502 switch (op->kind) {
503 case lexer::token::tokenKind::equal: handleBinaryOperatorOverload(L"operator=="); break;
504 case lexer::token::tokenKind::notEqual: handleBinaryOperatorOverload(L"operator!="); break;
505 default: panic(op->line, op->col, "Unexpected equality expression operator"); return {};
506 }
507 }
508 lhsPos = rhsPos;
509 }
510 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();

513 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::andExpr *andExpr) {
514 auto term = andExpr->getTerms().begin();
515 auto op = andExpr->getOp().begin();
516 auto lhsPos = visit(*term);
517 for (; op != andExpr->getOp().end(); ++op) {
518 auto rhsPos = visit(*++term);
519 auto &lhsType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getLhsFromTempVarStack();
520 auto &rhsType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
521
522 if (lhsType->isBasicType() && rhsType->isBasicType()) {
523 switch (op->kind) {
524 case lexer::token::tokenKind::binaryAnd: {
525 if (lhsType->isBasicType() && lhsType->type != IRValueType::valueType::integerObject) {
526 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(
527 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getIntObjectType(), lhsPos, true);
528 }
529 if (rhsType->isBasicType() && rhsType->type != IRValueType::valueType::integerObject) {
530 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getIntObjectType(),
531 rhsPos);
532 }
533
534 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().arithmeticOp(IR::Opcode::bitwise_and);
535 break;
536 }
537 default: {
538 panic(op->line, op->col, "Unexpected and expression operator");
539 return {};
540 }
541 }
542 } else {
543 switch (op->kind) {
544 case lexer::token::tokenKind::binaryAnd: {
545 handleBinaryOperatorOverload(L"operator&");
546 break;
547 }
548 default: {
549 panic(op->line, op->col, "Unexpected and expression operator");
550 return {};
551 }
552 }
553 }
554
555 lhsPos = rhsPos;
556 }
557 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
558 }

560 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::exclusiveExpr *exclusiveExpr) {
561 auto term = exclusiveExpr->getTerms().begin();
562 auto op = exclusiveExpr->getOp().begin();
563 auto lhs = visit(*term);
564 for (; op != exclusiveExpr->getOp().end(); ++op) {
565 auto rhs = visit(*++term);
566 auto &lhsType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getLhsFromTempVarStack();
567 auto &rhsType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
568
569 if (lhsType->isBasicType() && rhsType->isBasicType()) {
570 switch (op->kind) {
571 case lexer::token::tokenKind::binaryXor: {
572 if (lhsType->isBasicType() && lhsType->type != IRValueType::valueType::integerObject) {
573 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(
574 (moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getIntObjectType()), lhs, true);
575 }
576 if (rhsType->isBasicType() && rhsType->type != IRValueType::valueType::integerObject) {
577 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(
578 (moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getIntObjectType()), rhs);
579 }
580
581 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().arithmeticOp(IR::Opcode::bitwise_xor);
582 break;
583 }
584 default: {
585 panic(op->line, op->col, "Unexpected exclusive expression operator");
586 return {};
587 }
588 }
589 } else {
590 switch (op->kind) {
591 case lexer::token::tokenKind::binaryXor: {
592 handleBinaryOperatorOverload(L"operator^");
593 break;
594 }
595 default: {
596 panic(op->line, op->col, "Unexpected exclusive expression operator");
597 }
598 }
599 }
600 lhs = rhs;
601 }
602 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
603 }
604
605 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::inclusiveExpr *inclusiveExpr) {
606 auto term = inclusiveExpr->getTerms().begin();
607 auto op = inclusiveExpr->getOp().begin();
608 auto lhs = visit(*term);
609 for (; op != inclusiveExpr->getOp().end(); ++op) {
610 auto rhs = visit(*++term);
611 auto &lhsType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getLhsFromTempVarStack();
612 auto &rhsType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
613
614 if (lhsType->isBasicType() && rhsType->isBasicType()) {
615 switch (op->kind) {
616 case lexer::token::tokenKind::binaryOr: {
617 if (lhsType->isBasicType() && lhsType->type != IRValueType::valueType::integerObject) {
618 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(
619 (moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getIntObjectType()), lhs, true);
620 }
621 if (rhsType->isBasicType() && rhsType->type != IRValueType::valueType::integerObject) {
622 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(
623 (moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getIntObjectType()), rhs);
624 }
625
626 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().arithmeticOp(IR::Opcode::bitwise_or);
627 break;
628 }
629 default: {
630 panic(op->line, op->col, "Unexpected inclusive expression operator");
631 return {};
632 }
633 }
634 } else {
635 switch (op->kind) {
636 case lexer::token::tokenKind::binaryOr: {
637 handleBinaryOperatorOverload(L"operator|");
638 break;
639 }
640 default: {
641 panic(op->line, op->col, "Unexpected inclusive expression operator");
642 return {};
643 }
644 }
645 }
646 lhs = rhs;
647 }
648
649 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
650 }
651
652 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::logicalAndExpr *logicalAndExpr) {
653 if (logicalAndExpr->getOp().empty()) {
654 return visit(logicalAndExpr->getTerms().front());
655 }
656
657 auto finalFalseBlock = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
658 auto endBlock = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
659 auto terms = logicalAndExpr->getTerms().begin();
660 auto ops = logicalAndExpr->getOp().begin();
661
662 visit(*terms);
663 auto termType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
664 if (termType->type != IRValueType::valueType::booleanObject) {
665 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(
666 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getBoolObjectType(), {}, true);
667 }
668
669 for (; ops != logicalAndExpr->getOp().end(); ++ops) {
670 auto nextTermBlock = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
671
672 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpIfOp(IR::Opcode::jump_if_false, finalFalseBlock);
673 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpOp(nextTermBlock);
674
675 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(nextTermBlock);
676 visit(*++terms);
677
678 termType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
679 if (termType->type != IRValueType::valueType::booleanObject) {
680 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(
681 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getBoolObjectType(), {}, true);
682 }
683 }
684
685 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpOp(endBlock);
686
687 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(finalFalseBlock);
688 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().insert({IR::Opcode::push_boolean, {{IROperand::operandType::boolean, IROperand::operandValue{false}}}, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo()});
689 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpOp(endBlock);
690
691 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(endBlock);
692
693 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
694 }
695
696
697 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::logicalOrExpr *logicalOrExpr) {
698 auto term = logicalOrExpr->getTerms().begin();
699 auto op = logicalOrExpr->getOp().begin();
700 auto lhs = visit(*term);
701 // The type of the first term on the left
702 auto lhsType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
703
704 // Loop through chained operators, e.g., a || b || c
705 for (; op != logicalOrExpr->getOp().end(); ++op) {
706 auto nextConditionBlock = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
707 auto exitWithTrueBlock = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
708 auto exitWithFalseBlock = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
709 auto exitBlock = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
710
711 moduleContext->getIRBuilder()
712 .getCodeBlock(exitWithTrueBlock)
713 .insert({IR::Opcode::push_boolean, {{IROperand::operandType::boolean, true}}, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo()});
714 moduleContext->getIRBuilder()
715 .getCodeBlock(exitWithTrueBlock)
716 .insert({IR::Opcode::jump, {IROperand{IROperand::operandType::codeBlock, exitBlock}}, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo()});
717
718 moduleContext->getIRBuilder()
719 .getCodeBlock(exitWithFalseBlock)
720 .insert({IR::Opcode::push_boolean,
721 {IROperand{IROperand::operandType::boolean, IROperand::operandValue{false}}}, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo()});
722 moduleContext->getIRBuilder()
723 .getCodeBlock(exitWithFalseBlock)
724 .insert({IR::Opcode::jump, {{IROperand::operandType::codeBlock, exitBlock}}, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo()});
725
726 switch (op->kind) {
727 case lexer::token::tokenKind::logicOr: {
728 yoi_assert(lhsType->isBasicType(), op->line, op->col, "Not basic type for logical or");
729 if (lhsType->type != IRValueType::valueType::booleanObject) {
730 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(
731 (moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getBoolObjectType()), lhs, true);
732 }
733
734 // Short-circuit if the LHS (or intermediate result) is true
735 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpIfOp(IR::Opcode::jump_if_true, exitWithTrueBlock);
736 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpOp(nextConditionBlock);
737 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(nextConditionBlock);
738
739 // If not short-circuited, evaluate the RHS
740 auto rhs = visit(*++term);
741 auto rhsType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
742 yoi_assert(rhsType->isBasicType(), op->line, op->col, "Not basic type for logical or");
743 if (rhsType->type != IRValueType::valueType::booleanObject) {
744 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(
745 (moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getBoolObjectType()), rhs);
746 }
747
748 // The result of the expression is now on the stack
749 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpIfOp(IR::Opcode::jump_if_true, exitWithTrueBlock);
750 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpOp(exitWithFalseBlock);
751 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(exitBlock);
752
753 lhsType = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getBoolObjectType();
754 // same as before
755 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().pushTempVar(lhsType);
756 break;
757 }
758 default: {
759 panic(op->line, op->col, "Unexpected logical or expression operator");
760 return {};
761 }
762 }
763 }
764
765 if (!logicalOrExpr->getOp().empty()) {
766 // not single term, push a boolean result onto the stack
767 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().pushTempVar(lhsType);
768 }
769
770 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
771 }
772
773 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::rExpr *rExpr) {
774 return visit(&rExpr->getExpr());
775 }
776
777 void visitor::visit(yoi::codeBlock *codeBlock, bool notEmitNewBlockInstruction) {
778 if (!notEmitNewBlockInstruction) {
779 auto block = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
780 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpOp(block);
781 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(block);
782 }
783 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().irFuncDefinition()->getVariableTable().createScope();
784 for (auto stmt : codeBlock->getStmts()) {
785 visit(stmt);
786 }
787 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().irFuncDefinition()->getVariableTable().popScope();
788 }
789
790 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::memberExpr* memberExpr, bool isStoreOp) {
791 // take a snapshot for builder state
792 auto snapshotIndex = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().saveState();
793
794 auto it = memberExpr->getTerms().begin();
795 yoi::indexT targetModule = -1, lastModule = -1;
796 // 1. Resolve module prefixes (e.g., std::io)
797 while (it + 1 != memberExpr->getTerms().end() && (targetModule = isModuleName((*it)->id, lastModule)) != lastModule) {
798 it++;
799 lastModule = targetModule;
800 }
801
802 // 2. Handle static method calls (e.g., MyType::staticFunc())
803 // This is a special case where the base is a type name, not an instance.
804 std::shared_ptr<IRValueType> staticTypeBase{};
805 try {
806 if (it + 1 != memberExpr->getTerms().end()) {
807 staticTypeBase = managedPtr(parseTypeSpecExtern(*it, targetModule == -1 ? currentModuleIndex : targetModule));
808 }
809 } catch (std::runtime_error&) {
810 // Not a type name, so it's an instance member expression.
811 } catch (std::out_of_range&) {
812 // Not a type name, so it's an instance member expression.
813 }
814
815 if (staticTypeBase && staticTypeBase->type == IRValueType::valueType::structObject) {
816 auto memberNameNode = *(++it);
817 yoi_assert(!memberNameNode->getSubscript().empty() && memberNameNode->getSubscript().front()->isInvocation(),
818 memberNameNode->getLine(), memberNameNode->getColumn(), "Static member access must be a method call.");
819
820 auto& invocation = memberNameNode->getSubscript().front();
821 if(!handleInvocationExtern(memberNameNode->id->getId().node.strVal, invocation->args, staticTypeBase->typeAffiliateModule, staticTypeBase, true))
822 panic(memberNameNode->getLine(), memberNameNode->getColumn(), "No matching static method found for: " + wstring2string(memberNameNode->id->getId().get().strVal));
823 // After a static call, subsequent member accesses operate on its return value.
824 } else {
825 // 3. It's an instance member expression. Visit the base instance.
826 bool isFinalTerm = (it + 1 == memberExpr->getTerms().end());
827 if (targetModule == -1) {
828 visit(*it, isStoreOp && isFinalTerm);
829 } else {
830 visitExtern(*it, targetModule, isStoreOp && isFinalTerm);
831 }
832 }
833
834 // 4. Loop through the rest of the terms (.b, .c(), .d[i], etc.)
835 for (; it != memberExpr->getTerms().end();) {
836 ++it;
837 if (it == memberExpr->getTerms().end()) {
838 break;
839 }
840
841 auto currentTermNode = *it;
842 bool isFinalTerm = (std::next(it) == memberExpr->getTerms().end());
843
844 // The type of the object we are operating on (result of the previous term)
845 auto objectType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
846
847 // A. Handle the base of the current term (the identifier itself).
848 // It's either a field access or a method name.
849 if (currentTermNode->getSubscript().empty()) {
850 // Case: Simple field access like `obj.field`
851 if (objectType->isArrayType() || objectType->isDynamicArrayType()) {
852 if (currentTermNode->id->getId().get().strVal == L"length") {
853 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().arrayLengthOp();
854 } else {
855 panic(currentTermNode->getLine(), currentTermNode->getColumn(), "Only 'length' member is valid on array types.");
856 }
857 } else if (objectType->type == IRValueType::valueType::structObject) {
858 auto structDef = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(objectType->typeAffiliateModule)->structTable[objectType->typeIndex];
859 auto& memberName = currentTermNode->id->getId().get().strVal;
860 try {
861 auto nameInfo = structDef->lookupName(memberName);
862 if (nameInfo.type != IRStructDefinition::nameInfo::nameType::field) {
863 panic(currentTermNode->getLine(), currentTermNode->getColumn(), "Cannot access method '" + wstring2string(memberName) + "' as a field.");
864 }
865 auto fieldType = structDef->fieldTypes[nameInfo.index];
866
867 // A store operation can only happen on the very last term of the expression.
868 if (isStoreOp && isFinalTerm) {
869 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().restoreStateTemporarily();
870 tryCastTo(fieldType);
871 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().commitState();
872 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().storeMemberOp({IROperand::operandType::index, nameInfo.index});
873 } else {
874 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().discardState();
875 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().loadMemberOp({IROperand::operandType::index, nameInfo.index}, fieldType);
876 }
877 } catch (std::out_of_range&) {
878 panic(currentTermNode->getLine(), currentTermNode->getColumn(), "Struct '" + wstring2string(structDef->name) + "' has no field named '" + wstring2string(memberName) + "'.");
879 }
880 } else {
881 panic(currentTermNode->getLine(), currentTermNode->getColumn(), "Member access on a non-struct or non-array type is not allowed.");
882 }
883 } else {
884 // Case: Field access followed by operations `obj.field[i]()`, or a method call `obj.method()`
885 // We need to resolve if the identifier is a field or method. We prioritize method calls.
886 auto firstOp = currentTermNode->getSubscript().front();
887 bool isMethodCall = firstOp->isInvocation();
888
889 if (isMethodCall) {
890 if (objectType->type == IRValueType::valueType::structObject) {
891 if(!handleInvocationExtern(currentTermNode->id->getId().get().strVal, firstOp->args, objectType->typeAffiliateModule, objectType))
892 panic(currentTermNode->getLine(), currentTermNode->getColumn(), "No matching method found for: " + wstring2string(currentTermNode->id->getId().get().strVal));
893 } else if (objectType->type == IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject) {
894 // Interface method call logic... (was already correct)
895 if(!handleInvocationExtern(currentTermNode->id->getId().get().strVal, firstOp->args, objectType->typeAffiliateModule, objectType))
896 panic(currentTermNode->getLine(), currentTermNode->getColumn(), "No matching method found for: " + wstring2string(currentTermNode->id->getId().get().strVal));
897 }
898 } else {
899 // It's a field access followed by subscript, e.g., `obj.data[i]`
900 // First, load the field itself.
901 if (objectType->type == IRValueType::valueType::structObject) {
902 auto structDef = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(objectType->typeAffiliateModule)->structTable[objectType->typeIndex];
903 auto& fieldName = currentTermNode->id->getId().get().strVal;
904 try {
905 auto nameInfo = structDef->lookupName(fieldName);
906 if (nameInfo.type != IRStructDefinition::nameInfo::nameType::field) {
907 panic(currentTermNode->getLine(), currentTermNode->getColumn(), "Cannot subscript method '" + wstring2string(fieldName) + "'.");
908 }
909 auto fieldType = structDef->fieldTypes[nameInfo.index];
910 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().loadMemberOp({IROperand::operandType::index, nameInfo.index}, fieldType);
911 } catch (std::out_of_range&) {
912 panic(currentTermNode->getLine(), currentTermNode->getColumn(), "Struct '" + wstring2string(structDef->name) + "' has no field named '" + wstring2string(fieldName) + "'.");
913 }
914 } else {
915 panic(currentTermNode->getLine(), currentTermNode->getColumn(), "Member access on a non-struct type is not allowed here.");
916 }
917 }
918
919 // B. Now, process the chain of `()` and `[]` that follow the identifier.
920 auto subIt = isMethodCall ? std::next(currentTermNode->getSubscript().begin()) : currentTermNode->getSubscript().begin();
921 for (; subIt != currentTermNode->getSubscript().end(); ++subIt) {
922 auto sub = *subIt;
923 bool isFinalOperation = isFinalTerm && (std::next(subIt) == currentTermNode->getSubscript().end());
924 auto currentObjectType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
925
926 if (sub->isInvocation()) {
927 // This handles `obj.field[i]()` where `field[i]` returns a callable.
928 // Or `obj.method()()` where `method()` returns a callable.
929 panic(sub->getLine(), sub->getColumn(), "Chained function calls are not yet supported in this context.");
930 } else if (sub->isSubscript()) {
931 visit(sub->expr); // Evaluate the index and push it.
932 tryCastTo(moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getUnsignedObjectType());
933 auto indexType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
934 yoi_assert(indexType->type == IRValueType::valueType::unsignedObject, sub->getLine(), sub->getColumn(), "Array/subscript index must be an integer or unsigned integer.");
935
936 if (currentObjectType->isArrayType() || currentObjectType->isDynamicArrayType()) {
937 if (isStoreOp && isFinalOperation) {
938 // This handles `... = obj.field[i]`
939 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().storeOp(IR::Opcode::store_element, {});
940 } else {
941 // This handles `let x = obj.field[i]`
942 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().loadOp(IR::Opcode::load_element, {}, managedPtr(currentObjectType->getElementType()));
943 }
944 } else {
945 // Overloaded operator[]
946 if (isFinalOperation && isStoreOp) {
947 // current stack: [..., value, array, index]
948 auto value = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getLhsFromTempVarStack();
949 auto array = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
950 visit(sub->expr);
951 auto index = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
952
953 OverloadResult overload;
954 if (array->type == IRValueType::valueType::structObject)
955 overload = resolveOverloadExtern(L"operator[]",
956 {value, array, index},
957 array->typeAffiliateModule,
958 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()
959 ->getImportedModule(array->typeAffiliateModule)
960 ->structTable[array->typeIndex]);
961 /*else if(array->type == IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject)
962 overload = resolveOverloadInterface(L"operator[]", {value, array, index},
963 array->typeAffiliateModule,
964 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(array->typeAffiliateModule)->interfaceTable[array->typeIndex]);*/
965
966 yoi_assert(overload.found(),
967 sub->getLine(),
968 sub->getColumn(),
969 "No matching overload found for operator[].");
970 yoi_assert(!overload.isVariadic,
971 sub->getLine(),
972 sub->getColumn(),
973 "Variadic operator[] overloading is not supported.");
974
975 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().invokeMethodOp(
976 overload.functionIndex, 2, overload.function->returnType, false, true, array->typeAffiliateModule);
977 } else {
978 visit(sub->expr);
979 handleBinaryOperatorOverload(L"operator[]");
980 }
981 }
982 }
983 }
984 }
985 }
986
987 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().discardStateUntil(snapshotIndex);
988 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
989 }
990
991 void visitor::visit(yoi::inCodeBlockStmt *inCodeBlockStmt) {
992 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().setDebugInfo({irModule->modulePath, inCodeBlockStmt->getLine(), inCodeBlockStmt->getColumn()});
993
994 if (!checkMarcoSatisfaction(inCodeBlockStmt->marco))
995 return;
996
997 switch (inCodeBlockStmt->getKind()) {
998 case inCodeBlockStmt::vKind::ifStmt:
999 visit(inCodeBlockStmt->getValue().ifStmtVal);
1000 break;
1001 case inCodeBlockStmt::vKind::whileStmt:
1002 visit(inCodeBlockStmt->getValue().whileStmtVal);
1003 break;
1004 case inCodeBlockStmt::vKind::forStmt:
1005 visit(inCodeBlockStmt->getValue().forStmtVal);
1006 break;
1007 case inCodeBlockStmt::vKind::forEachStmt:
1008 visit(inCodeBlockStmt->getValue().forEachStmtVal);
1009 break;
1010 case inCodeBlockStmt::vKind::returnStmt:
1011 visit(inCodeBlockStmt->getValue().returnStmtVal);
1012 break;
1013 case inCodeBlockStmt::vKind::continueStmt:
1014 visit(inCodeBlockStmt->getValue().continueStmtVal);
1015 break;
1016 case inCodeBlockStmt::vKind::breakStmt:
1017 visit(inCodeBlockStmt->getValue().breakStmtVal);
1018 break;
1019 case inCodeBlockStmt::vKind::letStmt:
1020 visit(inCodeBlockStmt->getValue().letStmtVal);
1021 break;
1022 case inCodeBlockStmt::vKind::codeBlock:
1023 visit(inCodeBlockStmt->getValue().codeBlockVal);
1024 break;
1025 case inCodeBlockStmt::vKind::rExpr:
1026 visit(inCodeBlockStmt->getValue().rExprVal);
1027 // balance the stack
1028 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().popOp();
1029 break;
1030 }
1031 }
1032
1033 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::subscriptExpr *subscriptExpr, bool isStoreOp) {
1034 if (subscriptExpr->getSubscript().empty()) {
1035 return visit(subscriptExpr->id, isStoreOp);
1036 }
1037
1038 auto it = subscriptExpr->getSubscript().begin();
1039 auto end = subscriptExpr->getSubscript().end();
1040 auto &first_term = *it;
1041
1042 bool isType = false;
1043 std::shared_ptr<IRValueType> baseType;
1044 try {
1045 baseType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(subscriptExpr->id));
1046 isType = true;
1047 } catch (const std::runtime_error &) {
1048 isType = false;
1049 }
1050
1051 bool firstTermHandled = false;
1052
1053 // Case 1: Array initializer like `int[2](...)`
1054 if (isType && first_term->isSubscript()) {
1055 yoi::vec<yoi::indexT> dimensions;
1056 yoi::indexT size = 1;
1057 auto dim_it = it;
1058 while (dim_it != end && (*dim_it)->isSubscript()) {
1059 yoi_assert((*dim_it)->expr->getToken().kind == lexer::token::tokenKind::integer, (*dim_it)->expr->getLine(), (*dim_it)->expr->getColumn(), "Array dimension must be an integer.");
1060 dimensions.push_back((*dim_it)->expr->getToken().basicVal.vInt);
1061 size = size * dimensions.back();
1062 dim_it++;
1063 }
1064 yoi::indexT actualSize = 0;
1065 if (dim_it != end && (*dim_it)->isInvocation()) {
1066 for (auto &val : (*dim_it)->args->get()) {
1067 visit(val);
1068 tryCastTo(baseType);
1069 actualSize++;
1070 }
1071 it = ++dim_it;
1072 } else {
1073 it = dim_it;
1074 }
1075
1076 yoi_assert(size == actualSize, subscriptExpr->getLine(), subscriptExpr->getColumn(), "Array size (" + std::to_string(size) + ") does not match the initializer size (" + std::to_string(actualSize) + ").");
1077 generateNullInterfaceImplementation(managedPtr(baseType->getArrayType(dimensions)));
1078 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().newArrayOp(baseType, dimensions);
1079 }
1080 // Case 2: Invocation `id<...>(...)` or `id(...)`
1081 else if (first_term->isInvocation()) {
1082 firstTermHandled = true;
1083 auto baseName = subscriptExpr->id->getId().get().strVal;
1084 auto args = first_term->args;
1085 bool resolved = false;
1086
1087 // --- Step 1: Handle explicit template specialization if present ---
1088 if (subscriptExpr->id->hasTemplateArg()) {
1089 auto concreteTemplateArgs = parseTemplateArgs(subscriptExpr->id->getArg());
1090 if (irModule->funcTemplateAsts.contains(baseName)) {
1091 auto astNode = irModule->funcTemplateAsts.at(baseName);
1092 specializeFunctionTemplate(astNode, concreteTemplateArgs, currentModuleIndex);
1093 } else {
1094 try {
1095 auto baseType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(subscriptExpr->id));
1096 switch (baseType->type) {
1097 case IRValueType::valueType::structObject: baseName = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(baseType->typeAffiliateModule)->structTable.getKey(baseType->typeIndex); break;
1098 case IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject: baseName = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(baseType->typeAffiliateModule)->interfaceTable.getKey(baseType->typeIndex); break;
1099 default: panic(subscriptExpr->getLine(), subscriptExpr->getColumn(), "Cannot specialize type: except structObject or interfaceObject but got: " + yoi::wstring2string(baseType->to_string())); break;
1100 }
1101 } catch (const std::runtime_error &e) {
1102 panic(subscriptExpr->getLine(), subscriptExpr->getColumn(), "Could not resolve template specialization for function '" + wstring2string(baseName) + ": \n" + e.what());
1103 }
1104 }
1105 }
1106
1107 // --- Step 2: Unified Invocation Logic with correct precedence ---
1108
1109 // Attempt 0: Check whether is a accessible variable
1110 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().saveState();
1111 {
1112 bool isAccessible = false;
1113 try {
1114 visit(subscriptExpr->id, false);
1115 isAccessible = true;
1116 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().discardState();
1117 } catch (const std::runtime_error &) {
1118 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().restoreState();
1119 }
1120 if (isAccessible) {
1121 auto structObject = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
1122 if(structObject->type == IRValueType::valueType::structObject || structObject->type == IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject) {
1123 if(!handleInvocationExtern(L"operator()", args, currentModuleIndex, structObject))
1124 panic(subscriptExpr->getLine(), subscriptExpr->getColumn(), "No matching method found for: " + wstring2string(baseName));
1125 resolved = true;
1126 } else {
1127 panic(subscriptExpr->getLine(), subscriptExpr->getColumn(), "Cannot call operator() on non-struct object or interface object.");
1128 }
1129 }
1130 }
1131
1132 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().saveState();
1133 // Attempt 1: Struct Constructor (handles regular, variadic, and specialized template structs)
1134 if (irModule->structTable.contains(baseName)) {
1135 auto structIndex = irModule->structTable.getIndex(baseName);
1136 auto structType = irModule->structTable[structIndex];
1137 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().newStructOp(structIndex);
1138 auto rhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
1139 if (handleInvocationExtern(L"constructor", args, currentModuleIndex, rhs)) {
1140 resolved = true;
1141 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().discardState();
1142 } else {
1143 panic(subscriptExpr->getLine(), subscriptExpr->getColumn(), "Could not resolve constructor for struct '" + wstring2string(baseName) + "'.");
1144 }
1145 } else {
1146 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().restoreState();
1147 }
1148
1149 // Attempt 2: Free Function (handles regular, variadic, and implicit template functions)
1150 if (!resolved) {
1151 resolved = handleInvocationExtern(baseName, args, currentModuleIndex);
1152 }
1153
1154 // Attempt 3: Interface Constructor
1155 if (!resolved) {
1156 if (irModule->interfaceTable.contains(baseName)) {
1157 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().saveState();
1158 try {
1159 auto interfaceIndex = irModule->interfaceTable.getIndex(baseName);
1160 auto argTypes = evaluateArguments(args);
1161 yoi_assert(argTypes.size() == 1, subscriptExpr->getLine(), subscriptExpr->getColumn(), "Interface constructor expects exactly one argument.");
1162 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().newInterfaceOp(interfaceIndex);
1163 auto interfaceImplName = getInterfaceImplName({currentModuleIndex, interfaceIndex}, argTypes[0]);
1164 auto targetModule = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(argTypes[0]->typeAffiliateModule);
1165 auto interfaceImplIndex = targetModule->interfaceImplementationTable.getIndex(interfaceImplName);
1166 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().constructInterfaceImplOp(interfaceImplIndex, true, targetModule->identifier);
1167 resolved = true;
1168 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().discardState();
1169 } catch (const std::exception &) {
1170 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().restoreState();
1171 }
1172 }
1173 }
1174
1175 // Attempt 4: Imported Function
1176 if (!resolved) {
1177 if (irModule->externTable.contains(baseName)) {
1178 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().saveState();
1179 try {
1180 auto importedFunctionIndex = irModule->externTable.getIndex(baseName);
1181 yoi_assert(irModule->externTable[importedFunctionIndex]->type == IRExternEntry::externType::importedFunction,
1182 subscriptExpr->getLine(), subscriptExpr->getColumn(), "This is not an imported function.");
1183
1184 auto argTypes = evaluateArguments(args);
1185 auto importedFunc =
1186 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()
1187 ->getIRFFITable()
1188 ->importedLibraries[irModule->externTable[importedFunctionIndex]->affiliateModule]
1189 .importedFunctionTable[irModule->externTable[importedFunctionIndex]->itemIndex];
1190 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().invokeImportedOp(
1191 irModule->externTable[importedFunctionIndex]->affiliateModule,
1192 irModule->externTable[importedFunctionIndex]->itemIndex,
1193 argTypes.size(),
1194 importedFunc->returnType);
1195 resolved = true;
1196 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().discardState();
1197 } catch (const std::exception &) {
1198 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().restoreState();
1199 }
1200 }
1201 }
1202
1203 // Attempt 5: type alias
1204 if (auto it = irModule->typeAliases.find(baseName); it != irModule->typeAliases.end()) {
1205 if (it->second.type == IRValueType::valueType::structObject) {
1206 auto targetModule = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(it->second.typeAffiliateModule);
1207 auto structIndex = it->second.typeIndex;
1208 auto structType = targetModule->structTable[structIndex];
1209 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().newStructOp(structIndex, true, targetModule->identifier);
1210 auto rhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
1211 if (handleInvocationExtern(L"constructor", args, targetModule->identifier, rhs)) {
1212 resolved = true;
1213 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().discardState();
1214 } else {
1215 panic(subscriptExpr->getLine(), subscriptExpr->getColumn(), "Could not resolve constructor for struct '" + wstring2string(baseName) + "'.");
1216 }
1217 } else if (it->second.type == IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject) {
1218 auto targetModuleForInterface = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(it->second.typeAffiliateModule);
1219 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().saveState();
1220 try {
1221 // auto interfaceIndex = targetModuleForInterface->interfaceTable.getIndex(baseName);
1222 auto interfaceIndex = it->second.typeIndex;
1223 auto argTypes = evaluateArguments(args);
1224 yoi_assert(argTypes.size() == 1, subscriptExpr->getLine(), subscriptExpr->getColumn(), "Interface constructor expects exactly one argument.");
1225 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().newInterfaceOp(interfaceIndex, true, targetModuleForInterface->identifier);
1226 auto interfaceImplName = getInterfaceImplName({currentModuleIndex, interfaceIndex}, argTypes[0]);
1227 auto targetModule = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(argTypes[0]->typeAffiliateModule);
1228 auto interfaceImplIndex = targetModule->interfaceImplementationTable.getIndex(interfaceImplName);
1229 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().constructInterfaceImplOp(interfaceImplIndex, true, targetModule->identifier);
1230 resolved = true;
1231 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().discardState();
1232 } catch (const std::exception &) {
1233 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().restoreState();
1234 }
1235 } else {
1236 panic(first_term->getLine(), first_term->getColumn(), "invalid type alias type");
1237 }
1238 }
1239
1240 if (!resolved) {
1241 panic(subscriptExpr->getLine(), subscriptExpr->getColumn(), "Could not resolve call to '" + wstring2string(baseName) + "'. No matching function, constructor, or template found for the given arguments.");
1242 }
1243 }
1244 // Case 3: First term is a variable access for subsequent subscript `var[...]`
1245 else {
1246 visit(subscriptExpr->id, false); // Load the variable
1247 }
1248
1249 if (firstTermHandled) {
1250 it++;
1251 }
1252
1253 // --- Loop for subsequent terms (e.g., chained array access) ---
1254 while (it != end) {
1255 auto currentTerm = *it;
1256 bool isLastTerm = (std::next(it) == end);
1257 auto objectOnStackType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
1258
1259 if (currentTerm->isSubscript()) {
1260 if (handleSubscript(it, end, isStoreOp, isLastTerm)) continue;
1261 } else if (currentTerm->isInvocation()) {
1262 if(objectOnStackType->type == IRValueType::valueType::structObject || objectOnStackType->type == IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject) {
1263 if(!handleInvocationExtern(L"operator()", currentTerm->args, currentModuleIndex, objectOnStackType))
1264 panic(currentTerm->getLine(), currentTerm->getColumn(), "No matching method found for: " + wstring2string(subscriptExpr->id->getId().get().strVal));
1265 } else {
1266 panic(currentTerm->getLine(), currentTerm->getColumn(), "Cannot call operator() on non-struct object or interface object.");
1267 }
1268 }
1269 it++;
1270 }
1271
1272 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
1273 }
1274
1275
1276 yoi::indexT visitor::visitExtern(yoi::subscriptExpr *subscriptExpr, yoi::indexT targetModule, bool isStoreOp) {
1277 if (subscriptExpr->getSubscript().empty()) {
1278 return visitExtern(subscriptExpr->id, targetModule, isStoreOp);
1279 }
1280
1281 auto it = subscriptExpr->getSubscript().begin();
1282 auto end = subscriptExpr->getSubscript().end();
1283 auto &firstTerm = *it;
1284
1285 auto targetedModule = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(targetModule);
1286
1287 bool isType = false;
1288 std::shared_ptr<IRValueType> baseType;
1289 try {
1290 baseType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpecExtern(subscriptExpr->id, targetModule));
1291 isType = true;
1292 } catch (const std::out_of_range &) {
1293 isType = false;
1294 }
1295
1296 bool firstTermHandled = false;
1297
1298 // Case 1: Extern Array Initializer
1299 if (isType && firstTerm->isSubscript()) {
1300 yoi::vec<yoi::indexT> dimensions;
1301 yoi::indexT size = 1;
1302 auto dim_it = it;
1303 while (dim_it != end && (*dim_it)->isSubscript()) {
1304 yoi_assert((*dim_it)->expr->getToken().kind == lexer::token::tokenKind::integer, (*dim_it)->expr->getLine(), (*dim_it)->expr->getColumn(), "Array dimension must be an integer.");
1305 dimensions.push_back((*dim_it)->expr->getToken().basicVal.vInt);
1306 size = size * dimensions.back();
1307 dim_it++;
1308 }
1309 yoi::indexT actualSize = 0;
1310 if (dim_it != end && (*dim_it)->isInvocation()) {
1311 for (auto &val : (*dim_it)->args->get()) {
1312 visit(val);
1313 tryCastTo(baseType);
1314 actualSize++;
1315 }
1316 it = ++dim_it;
1317 } else {
1318 it = dim_it;
1319 }
1320 yoi_assert(size == actualSize, subscriptExpr->getLine(), subscriptExpr->getColumn(), "Array size (" + std::to_string(size) + ") does not match the initializer size (" + std::to_string(actualSize) + ").");
1321
1322 generateNullInterfaceImplementation(managedPtr(baseType->getArrayType(dimensions)));
1323 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().newArrayOp(baseType, dimensions);
1324 }
1325 // Case 2: Extern Invocation
1326 else if (firstTerm->isInvocation()) {
1327 firstTermHandled = true;
1328 auto baseName = subscriptExpr->id->getId().get().strVal;
1329 auto args = firstTerm->args;
1330 bool resolved = false;
1331
1332 // --- Step 1: Handle explicit template specialization if present ---
1333 if (subscriptExpr->id->hasTemplateArg()) {
1334 auto concreteTemplateArgs = parseTemplateArgs(subscriptExpr->id->getArg());
1335 if (targetedModule->funcTemplateAsts.contains(baseName)) {
1336 auto astNode = targetedModule->funcTemplateAsts.at(baseName);
1337 specializeFunctionTemplate(astNode, concreteTemplateArgs, targetModule);
1338 } else {
1339 try {
1340 auto baseType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpecExtern(subscriptExpr->id, targetModule));
1341 switch (baseType->type) {
1342 case IRValueType::valueType::structObject: baseName = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(baseType->typeAffiliateModule)->structTable.getKey(baseType->typeIndex); break;
1343 case IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject: baseName = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(baseType->typeAffiliateModule)->interfaceTable.getKey(baseType->typeIndex); break;
1344 default: panic(subscriptExpr->getLine(), subscriptExpr->getColumn(), "Cannot specialize type: except structObject or interfaceObject but got: " + yoi::wstring2string(baseType->to_string())); break;
1345 }
1346 } catch (const std::runtime_error &e) {
1347 panic(subscriptExpr->getLine(), subscriptExpr->getColumn(), "Could not resolve template specialization for function '" + wstring2string(baseName) + "'" + ": \n" + e.what() + "\n");
1348 }
1349 }
1350 }
1351
1352 // Attempt 1: Extern Struct Constructor (regular or variadic)
1353 if (targetedModule->structTable.contains(baseName)) {
1354 auto externStructEntry = getExternEntry(targetModule, baseName);
1355 auto targetedStruct = targetedModule->structTable[baseName];
1356
1357 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().newStructOp(externStructEntry.itemIndex, true, externStructEntry.affiliateModule);
1358 auto rhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
1359 if (handleInvocationExtern(L"constructor", args, targetModule, rhs)) {
1360 resolved = true;
1361 } else {
1362 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().popFromTempVarStack(); // Pop unused extern struct
1363 }
1364 }
1365
1366 // Attempt 2: Extern Free Function (regular or variadic)
1367 if (!resolved) {
1368 resolved = handleInvocationExtern(baseName, args, targetModule);
1369 }
1370
1371 // Attempt 3: Extern Interface Constructor
1372 if (!resolved) {
1373 if (targetedModule->interfaceTable.contains(baseName)) {
1374 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().saveState();
1375 try {
1376 auto argTypes = evaluateArguments(args);
1377 yoi_assert(argTypes.size() == 1, subscriptExpr->getLine(), subscriptExpr->getColumn(), "Interface constructor expects exactly one argument.");
1378
1379 auto concreteThis = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
1380
1381 auto externInterface = getExternEntry(targetModule, baseName);
1382 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().newInterfaceOp(externInterface.itemIndex, true, externInterface.affiliateModule);
1383
1384 auto interfaceImplName = getInterfaceImplName({externInterface.affiliateModule, externInterface.itemIndex}, argTypes[0]);
1385 auto interfaceImplIndex = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(concreteThis->typeAffiliateModule)->interfaceImplementationTable.getIndex(interfaceImplName);
1386 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().constructInterfaceImplOp(interfaceImplIndex, concreteThis->typeAffiliateModule != currentModuleIndex, concreteThis->typeAffiliateModule);
1387
1388 resolved = true;
1389 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().discardState();
1390 } catch (const std::out_of_range &e) {
1391 panic(subscriptExpr->getLine(), subscriptExpr->getColumn(), "Could not find matched extern interface constructor for " + wstring2string(baseName));
1392 }/* catch (const std::exception &e) {
1393 // panic(subscriptExpr->getLine(), subscriptExpr->getColumn(), "Could not find matched extern interface constructor for " + wstring2string(baseName));
1394 throw e;
1395 }*/
1396 }
1397 }
1398
1399 // Attempt 4: FFI Imported Function (via an extern module)
1400 if (!resolved) {
1401 if (targetedModule->externTable.contains(baseName)) {
1402 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().saveState();
1403 try {
1404 auto argTypes = evaluateArguments(args);
1405 auto externEntry = targetedModule->externTable[baseName];
1406 auto externFunc = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getIRFFITable()->importedLibraries[externEntry->affiliateModule].importedFunctionTable[externEntry->itemIndex];
1407 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().invokeImportedOp(externEntry->affiliateModule, externEntry->itemIndex, argTypes.size(), externFunc->returnType);
1408
1409 resolved = true;
1410 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().discardState();
1411 } catch (const std::exception &) {
1412 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().restoreState();
1413 }
1414 }
1415 }
1416
1417 if (!resolved) {
1418 panic(subscriptExpr->getLine(), subscriptExpr->getColumn(), "Could not find extern function, struct constructor, or interface in module: " + wstring2string(baseName));
1419 }
1420 } else { // First term is a variable access
1421 visitExtern(subscriptExpr->id, targetModule, false);
1422 }
1423
1424 if (firstTermHandled) {
1425 it++;
1426 }
1427
1428 // --- Loop for subsequent terms ---
1429 while (it != end) {
1430 auto currentTerm = *it;
1431 auto objectOnStackType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
1432
1433 if (currentTerm->isSubscript()) {
1434 panic(currentTerm->getLine(),
1435 currentTerm->getColumn(),
1436 "TODO: Extern array access is not fully implemented yet.");
1437 } else if (currentTerm->isInvocation()) {
1438 if(objectOnStackType->type == IRValueType::valueType::structObject || objectOnStackType->type == IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject) {
1439 handleInvocationExtern(L"operator()", currentTerm->args, currentModuleIndex, objectOnStackType);
1440 } else {
1441 panic(currentTerm->getLine(), currentTerm->getColumn(), "Cannot call operator() on non-struct object or interface object.");
1442 }
1443 }
1444 it++;
1445 }
1446
1447 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
1448 }
1449
1450
1451 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::identifierWithTemplateArg *identifierWithTemplateArg, bool isStoreOp) {
1452 if (identifierWithTemplateArg->hasTemplateArg()) {
1453 panic(identifierWithTemplateArg->getLine(), identifierWithTemplateArg->getColumn(), "Invalid visit of identifier with template arg.");
1454 } else {
1455 return visit(identifierWithTemplateArg->id, isStoreOp);
1456 }
1457 }

1459 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::useStmt *useStmt) {
1460 auto index = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->compileModule(useStmt->path.strVal);
1461 irModule->moduleImports[useStmt->name->get().strVal] = index;
1462 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
1463 }
1464
1465 IRValueType visitor::parseTypeSpec(yoi::identifier *identifier) {
1466 auto &typeName = identifier->node.strVal;
1467 try {
1468 return irModule->typeAliases.at(typeName);
1469 } catch (std::out_of_range &e) {
1470 // let it go
1471 }
1472 try {
1473 auto typeIndex = irModule->structTable.getIndex(typeName);
1474 return IRValueType{
1475 IRValueType::valueType::structObject, static_cast<yoi::indexT>(currentModuleIndex), typeIndex};
1476 } catch (std::out_of_range &e) {
1477 // let it go
1478 }
1479 try {
1480 auto typeIndex = irModule->interfaceTable.getIndex(typeName);
1481 return IRValueType{
1482 IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject, static_cast<yoi::indexT>(currentModuleIndex), typeIndex};
1483 } catch (std::out_of_range &e) {
1484 // let it go
1485 }
1486 try {
1487 auto incompleteType = getIncompleteType(typeName);
1488 return *incompleteType;
1489 } catch (std::out_of_range &e) {
1490 // let it go
1491 }
1492 if (typeName == L"int") {
1493 return *moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getIntObjectType();
1494 } else if (typeName == L"bool") {
1495 return *moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getBoolObjectType();
1496 } else if (typeName == L"deci") {
1497 return *moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getDeciObjectType();
1498 } else if (typeName == L"string") {
1499 return *moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getStrObjectType();
1500 } else if (typeName == L"none") {
1501 return *moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getNoneObjectType();
1502 } else if (typeName == L"char") {
1503 return *moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getCharObjectType();
1504 } else if (typeName == L"int32") {
1505 return *moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getForeignInt32ObjectType();
1506 } else if (typeName == L"float") {
1507 return *moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getForeignFloatObjectType();
1508 } else if (typeName == L"ptr") {
1509 return *moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getPointerType();
1510 } else if (typeName == L"unsigned") {
1511 return *moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getUnsignedObjectType();
1512 } else if (typeName == L"short") {
1513 return *moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getShortObjectType();
1514 } else {
1515 panic(identifier->getLine(), identifier->getColumn(), "Unsupported type: " + wstring2string(typeName));
1516 }
1517 }
1518
1519 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::funcDefStmt *funcDefStmt) {
1520 auto funcName = funcDefStmt->getId();
1521
1522 if (funcName.hasDefTemplateArg()) {
1523 auto actualName = funcName.getId().node.strVal;
1524 irModule->funcTemplateAsts[actualName] = funcDefStmt;
1525 } else {
1526 bool isVaridic = false;
1527
1528 auto funcType = parseTypeSpec(&funcDefStmt->getResultType());
1529 IRFunctionDefinition::Builder builder;
1530
1531 builder.setDebugInfo({irModule->modulePath, funcDefStmt->getLine(), funcDefStmt->getColumn()});
1532
1533 builder.attrs = getFunctionAttributes(funcDefStmt->attrs);
1534
1535 builder.setReturnType(managedPtr(funcType));
1536 std::vector<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> argTypes;
1537 for (auto &i : funcDefStmt->getArgs().get()) {
1538 if (&i == &funcDefStmt->getArgs().get().back() && i->spec->kind == 3 /* elipsis */) {
1539 isVaridic = true;
1540 builder.addAttr(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Variadic);
1541 auto argName = i->getId().node.strVal;
1542 auto argType = managedPtr(moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getNullInterfaceType()->getDynamicArrayType());
1543 builder.addArgument(argName, argType);
1544 argTypes.push_back(argType);
1545 break;
1546 }
1547
1548 auto argName = i->getId().node.strVal;
1549 auto argType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(i->spec));
1550 argTypes.push_back(argType);
1551 builder.addArgument(argName, argType);
1552 }
1553
1554 builder.setName(funcName.getId().node.strVal + getFuncUniqueNameStr(argTypes));
1555
1556 auto func = builder.yield();
1557
1558 auto funcIndex = irModule->functionTable.put(builder.name, func);
1559 irModule->functionOverloadIndexies[funcName.getId().node.strVal].push_back(funcIndex);
1560
1561 moduleContext->pushIRBuilder({moduleContext->getCompilerContext(), irModule, func});
1562 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().setDebugInfo({irModule->modulePath, funcDefStmt->getLine(), funcDefStmt->getColumn()});
1563 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock());
1564 visit(funcDefStmt->block, true);
1565 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().yield();
1566 moduleContext->popIRBuilder();
1567 }
1568 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
1569 }
1570
1571 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::interfaceDefStmt *interfaceDefStmt) {
1572 if (interfaceDefStmt->id->hasDefTemplateArg()) {
1573 auto &interfaceName = interfaceDefStmt->id->getId().get().strVal;
1574
1575 irModule->templateInterfaceAsts[interfaceName] = interfaceDefStmt;
1576
1577 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
1578 }
1579
1580 auto &interfaceName = interfaceDefStmt->id->getId().get().strVal;
1581 auto interfaceIndex = irModule->interfaceTable.put(interfaceName, {});
1582
1583 IRInterfaceInstanceDefinition::Builder builder;
1584 builder.setName(interfaceName);
1585 for (auto &i : interfaceDefStmt->getInner().getInner()) {
1586 bool isVaridic = false;
1587 yoi_assert(i->isMethod(), i->getLine(), i->getColumn(), "Interface member must be a method");
1588
1589 auto methodName = i->getMethod().getName().get().strVal;
1590 auto methodResultType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(i->getMethod().resultType));
1591 yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> argTypes;
1592 IRFunctionDefinition::Builder methodBuilder;
1593
1594 methodBuilder.setDebugInfo({irModule->modulePath, i->getLine(), i->getColumn()});
1595
1596 methodBuilder.setReturnType(methodResultType);
1597 for (auto &arg : i->getMethod().getArgs().get()) {
1598 if (&arg == &i->getMethod().getArgs().get().back() && arg->spec->kind == 3 /* elipsis */) {
1599 isVaridic = true;
1600 methodBuilder.addAttr(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Variadic);
1601 auto argName = arg->getId().node.strVal;
1602 auto argType = managedPtr(moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getNullInterfaceType()->getDynamicArrayType());
1603 methodBuilder.addArgument(argName, argType);
1604 argTypes.push_back(argType);
1605 break;
1606 }
1607
1608 auto argName = arg->getId().get().strVal;
1609 auto argType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(arg->spec));
1610 methodBuilder.addArgument(argName, argType);
1611 argTypes.push_back(argType);
1612 }
1613 auto methodFuncName = L"interface#" + interfaceName + L"#" + methodName;
1614 auto uniq = getFuncUniqueNameStr(argTypes);
1615 methodBuilder.setName(methodFuncName + uniq);
1616
1617 auto func = methodBuilder.yield();
1618 builder.addMethod(methodName + uniq, func);
1619 }
1620 auto interfaceType = builder.yield();
1621 irModule->interfaceTable[interfaceIndex] = interfaceType;
1622 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
1623 }
1624
1625 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::structDefStmt *structDefStmt) {
1626 auto &structName = structDefStmt->id->getId().get().strVal;
1627
1628 if (structDefStmt->getId().hasDefTemplateArg()) {
1629 irModule->structTemplateAsts[structName] = structDefStmt;
1630 } else {
1631 auto structIndex = irModule->structTable.put(structName, {});
1632
1633 generateNullInterfaceImplementation(managedPtr(IRValueType{IRValueType::valueType::structObject, currentModuleIndex, structIndex}));
1634
1635 IRStructDefinition::Builder builder;
1636 builder.setName(structName);
1637 for (auto &i : structDefStmt->getInner().getInner()) {
1638 switch (i->kind) {
1639 case 0: {
1640 auto memberName = i->getVar().getId().get().strVal;
1641 auto memberType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(i->getVar().spec));
1642 builder.addField(memberName, memberType);
1643 break;
1644 }
1645 case 1: {
1646 bool isVaridic = false;
1647 IRFunctionDefinition::Builder constructorBuilder;
1648
1649 constructorBuilder.setDebugInfo({irModule->modulePath, i->getLine(), i->getColumn()});
1650 constructorBuilder.addAttr(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Constructor);
1651
1652 yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> argTypes;
1653 auto thisType = managedPtr(
1654 IRValueType{IRValueType::valueType::structObject, currentModuleIndex, structIndex});
1655 constructorBuilder.setReturnType(thisType);
1656 constructorBuilder.addArgument(L"this", thisType);
1657 constructorBuilder.addAttr(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Constructor);
1658 for (auto &arg : i->getConstructor().getArgs().get()) {
1659 if (&arg == &i->getConstructor().getArgs().get().back() && arg->spec->kind == 3 /* elipsis */) {
1660 isVaridic = true;
1661 constructorBuilder.addAttr(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Variadic);
1662 auto argName = arg->getId().node.strVal;
1663 auto argType = managedPtr(moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getNullInterfaceType()->getDynamicArrayType());
1664 constructorBuilder.addArgument(argName, argType);
1665 argTypes.push_back(argType);
1666 break;
1667 }
1668 auto argName = arg->getId().get().strVal;
1669 auto argType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(arg->spec));
1670 constructorBuilder.addArgument(argName, argType);
1671 argTypes.push_back(argType);
1672 }
1673 auto uniq = getFuncUniqueNameStr(argTypes);
1674 auto mangledName = L"constructor" + uniq;
1675 constructorBuilder.setName(structName + L"::" + mangledName);
1676
1677 auto func = constructorBuilder.yield();
1678 auto funcIndex = irModule->functionTable.put_create(func->name, func);
1679 builder.addMethod(mangledName, funcIndex);
1680 irModule->functionOverloadIndexies[structName + L"::constructor"].push_back(funcIndex);
1681 break;
1682 }
1683 case 2: {
1684 bool isVaridic = false;
1685 auto methodName = i->getMethod().getName().get().strVal;
1686 auto methodType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(i->getMethod().resultType));
1687 IRFunctionDefinition::Builder methodBuilder;
1688
1689 methodBuilder.attrs = getFunctionAttributes(i->getMethod().attrs);
1690 methodBuilder.setDebugInfo({irModule->modulePath, i->getLine(), i->getColumn()});
1691
1692 yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> argTypes;
1693
1694 methodBuilder.setReturnType(methodType);
1695 auto thisType = managedPtr(
1696 IRValueType{IRValueType::valueType::structObject, currentModuleIndex, structIndex});
1697
1698 if (std::find(methodBuilder.attrs.begin(), methodBuilder.attrs.end(), IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Static) == methodBuilder.attrs.end())
1699 methodBuilder.addArgument(L"this", thisType);
1700
1701 for (auto &arg : i->getMethod().getArgs().get()) {
1702 if (&arg == &i->getMethod().getArgs().get().back() && arg->spec->kind == 3 /* elipsis */) {
1703 isVaridic = true;
1704 methodBuilder.addAttr(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Variadic);
1705 auto argName = arg->getId().node.strVal;
1706 auto argType = managedPtr(moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getNullInterfaceType()->getDynamicArrayType());
1707 methodBuilder.addArgument(argName, argType);
1708 argTypes.push_back(argType);
1709 break;
1710 }
1711 auto argName = arg->getId().get().strVal;
1712 auto argType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(arg->spec));
1713 methodBuilder.addArgument(argName, argType);
1714 argTypes.push_back(argType);
1715 }
1716
1717 auto uniq = getFuncUniqueNameStr(argTypes);
1718 auto mangledName = methodName + uniq;
1719 methodBuilder.setName(structName + L"::" + mangledName);
1720 auto func = methodBuilder.yield();
1721 auto funcIndex = irModule->functionTable.put_create(func->name, func);
1722 builder.addMethod(mangledName, funcIndex);
1723 irModule->functionOverloadIndexies[structName + L"::" + methodName].push_back(funcIndex);
1724 break;
1725 }
1726 }
1727 }
1728 auto structType = builder.yield();
1729 irModule->structTable[structIndex] = structType;
1730 }
1731 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
1732 }
