1734 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::implStmt *implStmt) {
1735 auto &structIdNode = implStmt->getStructId();
1736
1737 auto it = structIdNode.getTerms().begin();
1738 yoi::indexT targetModule = -1, lastModule = -1;
1739 while (it + 1 != structIdNode.getTerms().end() && (targetModule = isModuleName(*it, targetModule)) != lastModule) {
1740 it++;
1741 lastModule = targetModule;
1742 }
1743 if (targetModule == -1) {
1744 targetModule = currentModuleIndex;
1745 }
1746 yoi_assert(it + 1 == structIdNode.getTerms().end(),
1747 structIdNode.getLine(),
1748 structIdNode.getColumn(),
1749 "Invalid interface name");
1750
1751 auto targetedModule = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(targetModule);
1752 auto structBaseName = (*it)->getId().get().strVal;
1753
1754 if ((*it)->hasTemplateArg()) {
1755 // Impl for a template struct
1756 yoi_assert(targetedModule->structTemplateAsts.contains(structBaseName),
1757 implStmt->getLine(),
1758 implStmt->getColumn(),
1759 "Impl for undefined struct template: " + wstring2string(structBaseName));
1760
1761 yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> concreteTemplateArgs = parseTemplateArgs((*it)->getArg());
1762
1763 if (implStmt->isImplForStmt()) {
1764 // interface implementation for a template struct
1765 if (concreteTemplateArgs.empty()) {
1766 targetedModule->templateInterfaceImplAsts[structBaseName].push_back(implStmt);
1767 } else {
1768 // specialize template interface
1769 auto interfaceTemplateAst = targetedModule->templateInterfaceAsts[structBaseName];
1770 auto concreteStructName = getMangledTemplateName(structBaseName, concreteTemplateArgs);
1771 auto concreteStructType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(implStmt->structName)); // quick specialization check
1772 yoi_assert(concreteStructType->type == IRValueType::valueType::structObject, implStmt->getLine(), implStmt->getColumn(), "Invalid struct name for struct specialization: " + wstring2string(concreteStructName) + " (except structObject but got " + wstring2string(concreteStructType->to_string()) + ")");
1773 // FIXED: module index
1774 specializeInterfaceImplementation(implStmt, concreteStructType, concreteStructName, concreteTemplateArgs, targetModule);
1775 }
1776 } else {
1777 if (concreteTemplateArgs.empty()) {
1778 // pure template struct, store them and specialize when used
1779 targetedModule->templateImplAsts[structBaseName] = implStmt;
1780 } else {
1781 // specialize template struct
1782 auto structTemplateAst = targetedModule->structTemplateAsts[structBaseName];
1783 specializeStructTemplate(structBaseName, concreteTemplateArgs, implStmt, targetModule);
1784 }
1785 }
1786
1787
1788 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
1789 }
1790
1791 if (implStmt->isImplForStmt()) {
1792 auto interfaceName = parseInterfaceName(implStmt->interfaceName);
1793 std::shared_ptr<IRValueType> srcType;
1794 try {
1795 srcType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(implStmt->structName));
1796 targetModule = srcType->typeAffiliateModule;
1797 targetedModule = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(targetModule);
1798 } catch (std::runtime_error &e) {
1799 panic(
1800 implStmt->getLine(), implStmt->getColumn(), "Undefined struct: " + wstring2string(structBaseName));
1801 return {};
1802 }
1803 auto targetInterface = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(interfaceName.first.first)->interfaceTable[interfaceName.first.second];
1804 targetInterface->implementations.emplace_back(
1805 srcType->type, srcType->typeAffiliateModule, srcType->typeIndex
1806 );
1807 auto interfaceImplName =
1808 getInterfaceImplName(interfaceName.first, srcType);
1809
1810
1811 yoi::indexT interfaceImplIndex{};
1812 try {
1813 interfaceImplIndex = targetedModule->interfaceImplementationTable.getIndex(interfaceImplName);
1814 if (targetedModule->interfaceImplementationTable[interfaceImplIndex]) {
1815 panic(
1816 implStmt->getLine(),
1817 implStmt->getColumn(),
1818 "Redefinition of interface implementation: " + wstring2string(interfaceImplName));
1819 }
1820 } catch (std::out_of_range &e) {
1821 interfaceImplIndex = targetedModule->interfaceImplementationTable.put(interfaceImplName, {});
1822 }
1823 if (implStmt->inner) {
1824 IRInterfaceImplementationDefinition::Builder builder;
1825 builder.setName(interfaceImplName);
1826 builder.setImplStructIndex({srcType->type, srcType->typeAffiliateModule, srcType->typeIndex});
1827 builder.setImplInterfaceIndex(interfaceName.first.second);
1828
1829 std::map<yoi::wstr, std::pair<yoi::wstr, std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>>> virtualMethodMap;
1830
1831 for (auto &i : implStmt->getInner().getInner()) {
1832 yoi_assert(!i->isConstructor(),
1833 i->getLine(),
1834 i->getColumn(),
1835 "Constructor cannot be implemented for interface");
1836
1837 bool isVaridic = false;
1838
1839 auto methodName = i->getMethod().getName().get().strVal;
1840 IRFunctionDefinition::Builder methodBuilder;
1841
1842 methodBuilder.setDebugInfo({irModule->modulePath, i->getLine(), i->getColumn()});
1843 methodBuilder.attrs = getFunctionAttributes(i->getMethod().attrs);
1844 methodBuilder.attrs.emplace_back(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Preserve);
1845 methodBuilder.attrs.emplace_back(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::NoRawAndNullOptimization);
1846
1847 yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> argTypes;
1848
1849 const auto& thisType = srcType;
1850 if (std::find(methodBuilder.attrs.begin(), methodBuilder.attrs.end(), IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Static) == methodBuilder.attrs.end())
1851 methodBuilder.addArgument(L"this", thisType);
1852
1853 for (auto &arg : i->getMethod().getArgs().get()) {
1854 if (&arg == &i->getMethod().getArgs().get().back() && arg->spec->kind == 3 /* elipsis */) {
1855 isVaridic = true;
1856 methodBuilder.addAttr(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Variadic);
1857 auto argName = arg->getId().node.strVal;
1858 auto argType = managedPtr(moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getNullInterfaceType()->getDynamicArrayType());
1859 methodBuilder.addArgument(argName, argType);
1860 argTypes.push_back(argType);
1861 break;
1862 }
1863 auto argName = arg->getId().get().strVal;
1864 auto argType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(arg->spec));
1865 methodBuilder.addArgument(argName, argType);
1866 argTypes.push_back(argType);
1867 }
1868 auto uniq = getFuncUniqueNameStr(argTypes);
1869 methodBuilder.setReturnType(managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(i->getMethod().resultType)));
1870 methodBuilder.setName(structBaseName + L"::" + methodName + uniq + L"interfaceImpl#" + interfaceImplName);
1871
1872 auto func = methodBuilder.yield();
1873 auto funcIndex = targetedModule->functionTable.put_create(func->name, func);
1874 targetedModule->functionOverloadIndexies[structBaseName + L"::" + methodName + L"interfaceImpl#" + interfaceImplName].push_back(funcIndex);
1875 /*builder.addVirtualMethod(
1876 methodName + uniq,
1877 managedPtr(IRValueType{IRValueType::valueType::virtualMethod, targetModule, funcIndex}));*/
1878 virtualMethodMap[methodName + getFuncUniqueNameStr(argTypes, true)] = {methodName + uniq, managedPtr(IRValueType{IRValueType::valueType::virtualMethod, targetModule, funcIndex})};
1879
1880 moduleContext->pushIRBuilder(IRBuilder{moduleContext->getCompilerContext(), irModule, func});
1881 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().setDebugInfo({irModule->modulePath, i->getLine(), i->getColumn()});
1882 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock());
1883 visit(i->getMethod().block, true);
1884 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().yield();
1885 moduleContext->popIRBuilder();
1886 }
1887
1888 for (auto &method: targetInterface->methodMap) {
1889 yoi_assert(virtualMethodMap.contains(method.first), implStmt->getLine(), implStmt->getColumn(), "Method '" + wstring2string(method.first) + "' not implemented for interface '" + wstring2string(targetInterface->name) + "'");
1890 builder.addVirtualMethod(virtualMethodMap[method.first].first, virtualMethodMap[method.first].second);
1891 }
1892
1893 targetedModule->interfaceImplementationTable[interfaceImplIndex] = builder.yield();
1894 } else {
1895 // forward-declaration
1896 }
1897 } else {
1898 indexT structIndex;
1899 try {
1900 structIndex = targetedModule->structTable.getIndex(structBaseName);
1901 } catch (std::runtime_error &e) {
1902 panic(
1903 implStmt->getLine(), implStmt->getColumn(), "Undefined struct: " + wstring2string(structBaseName));
1904 }
1905
1906 for (auto &i : implStmt->getInner().getInner()) {
1907 yoi::wstr mangledName;
1908 if (i->isConstructor()) {
1909 bool isVaridic = false;
1910 yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> argTypes;
1911 for (auto &arg : i->getConstructor().getArgs().get()) {
1912 if (&arg == &i->getConstructor().getArgs().get().back() && arg->spec->kind == 3 /* elipsis */) {
1913 isVaridic = true;
1914 auto argType = managedPtr(moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getNullInterfaceType()->getDynamicArrayType());
1915 argTypes.push_back(argType);
1916 break;
1917 }
1918 argTypes.push_back(managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(arg->spec)));
1919 }
1920 mangledName = structBaseName + L"::constructor" + getFuncUniqueNameStr(argTypes);
1921 } else {
1922 // whole bunch of shit doin' here is to get the mangled name of the method, no actual modification of original func def here.
1923 bool isVaridic = false;
1924 yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> argTypes;
1925 for (auto &arg : i->getMethod().getArgs().get()) {
1926 if (&arg == &i->getMethod().getArgs().get().back() && arg->spec->kind == 3 /* elipsis */) {
1927 isVaridic = true;
1928 auto argType = managedPtr(moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getNullInterfaceType()->getDynamicArrayType());
1929 argTypes.push_back(argType);
1930 break;
1931 }
1932 argTypes.push_back(managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(arg->spec)));
1933 }
1934 mangledName =
1935 structBaseName + L"::" + i->getMethod().getName().get().strVal + getFuncUniqueNameStr(argTypes);
1936 }
1937
1938 try {
1939 auto funcIndex = targetedModule->functionTable.getIndex(mangledName);
1940 auto func = targetedModule->functionTable[funcIndex];
1941 moduleContext->pushIRBuilder({moduleContext->getCompilerContext(), irModule, func});
1942 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().setDebugInfo({irModule->modulePath, i->getLine(), i->getColumn()});
1943 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock());
1944 visit(i->isConstructor() ? i->getConstructor().block : i->getMethod().block, true);
1945 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().yield();
1946 moduleContext->popIRBuilder();
1947 } catch (std::out_of_range &e) {
1948 panic(i->getLine(),
1949 i->getColumn(),
1950 "No matched constructor or method declaration found for impl: " +
1951 wstring2string(mangledName));
1952 }
1953 }
1954 }
1955 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
1956 }

1958 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::letStmt *letStmt) {
1959 for (auto &i : letStmt->terms) {
1960 visit(i->rhs);
1961 auto type = i->type ? managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(i->type)) : moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
1962 if (isVisitingGlobalScope()) {
1963 // global variable
1964 tryCastTo(type);
1965 auto index = irModule->globalVariables.put(i->lhs->node.strVal, type);
1966 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().storeOp(IR::Opcode::store_global,
1967 {IROperand::operandType::globalVar, index});
1968
1969 } else {
1970 tryCastTo(type);
1971 auto index =
1972 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().irFuncDefinition()->getVariableTable().put(i->lhs->node.strVal, type);
1973 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().storeOp(IR::Opcode::store_local,
1974 {IROperand::operandType::localVar, index});
1975 }
1976 }
1977 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
1978 }

1980 void visitor::visit(yoi::globalStmt *globalStmt) {
1981 if (!checkMarcoSatisfaction(globalStmt->marco))
1982 return;
1983 switch (globalStmt->kind) {
1984 case globalStmt::vKind::useStmt: {
1985 visit(globalStmt->value.useStmtVal);
1986 break;
1987 }
1988 case globalStmt::vKind::implStmt: {
1989 visit(globalStmt->value.implStmtVal);
1990 break;
1991 }
1992 case globalStmt::vKind::letStmt: {
1993 visit(globalStmt->value.letStmtVal);
1994 break;
1995 }
1996 case globalStmt::vKind::funcDefStmt: {
1997 visit(globalStmt->value.funcDefStmtVal);
1998 break;
1999 }
2000 case globalStmt::vKind::structDefStmt: {
2001 visit(globalStmt->value.structDefStmtVal);
2002 break;
2003 }
2004 case globalStmt::vKind::interfaceDefStmt: {
2005 visit(globalStmt->value.interfaceDefStmtVal);
2006 break;
2007 }
2008 case globalStmt::vKind::importDecl: {
2009 visit(globalStmt->value.importDeclVal);
2010 break;
2011 }
2012 case globalStmt::vKind::exportDecl: {
2013 visit(globalStmt->value.exportDeclVal);
2014 break;
2015 }
2016 case globalStmt::vKind::typeAliasStmt: {
2017 visit(globalStmt->value.typeAliasStmtVal);
2018 break;
2019 }
2020 default: {
2021 panic(globalStmt->getLine(), globalStmt->getColumn(), "Unsupported global statement type");
2022 }
2023 }
2024 }

2026 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::ifStmt *ifStmt) {
2027 visit(ifStmt->getIfBlock().cond);
2028 auto condType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
2029 yoi_assert(condType->type == IRValueType::valueType::booleanObject,
2030 ifStmt->getLine(),
2031 ifStmt->getColumn(),
2032 "The type in if-condition must be boolean");
2033
2034 auto ifBlock = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
2035 auto outBlock = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
2036
2037 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpIfOp(IR::Opcode::jump_if_true, ifBlock);
2038 auto back = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(ifBlock);
2039 visit(ifStmt->getIfBlock().block, true);
2040 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpOp(outBlock);
2041 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(back);
2042
2043 for (auto &i : ifStmt->elifB) {
2044 visit(i.cond);
2045 auto elifCondType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
2046 yoi_assert(elifCondType->type == IRValueType::valueType::booleanObject,
2047 i.cond->getLine(),
2048 i.cond->getColumn(),
2049 "The type in elif-condition must be boolean");
2050
2051 auto elifBlock = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
2052 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpIfOp(IR::Opcode::jump_if_true, elifBlock);
2053 auto back = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(elifBlock);
2054 visit(i.block, true);
2055 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpOp(outBlock);
2056 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(back);
2057 }
2058
2059 if (ifStmt->hasElseBlock()) {
2060 auto elseBlock = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
2061 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpOp(elseBlock);
2062 auto back = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(elseBlock);
2063 visit(ifStmt->elseB, true);
2064 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpOp(outBlock);
2065 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(back);
2066 } else {
2067 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpOp(outBlock);
2068 }
2069 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(outBlock);
2070 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
2071 }
2072
2073 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::whileStmt *whileStmt) {
2074 auto condBlock = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
2075 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpOp(condBlock);
2076 auto back = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(condBlock);
2077
2078 visit(whileStmt->cond);
2079 auto condType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
2080 yoi_assert(condType->type == IRValueType::valueType::booleanObject,
2081 whileStmt->getLine(),
2082 whileStmt->getColumn(),
2083 "The type in while-condition must be boolean");
2084
2085 auto whileBlock = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
2086 auto outBlock = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
2087
2088 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpIfOp(IR::Opcode::jump_if_true, whileBlock);
2089 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpOp(outBlock);
2090 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(whileBlock);
2091 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().pushLoopContext(outBlock, condBlock);
2092 visit(whileStmt->block, true);
2093 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().popLoopContext();
2094
2095 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpOp(condBlock);
2096 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(outBlock);
2097
2098 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
2099 }

2101 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::forStmt *forStmt) {
2102 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().irFuncDefinition()->getVariableTable().createScope();
2103 auto initBlock = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
2104 auto condBlock = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
2105 auto codeBlock = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
2106 auto afterBlock = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
2107 auto outBlock = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock();
2108
2109 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpOp(initBlock);
2110
2111 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(initBlock);
2112 visit(forStmt->initStmt);
2113
2114 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpOp(condBlock);
2115 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(condBlock);
2116 visit(forStmt->cond);
2117 auto condType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
2118 yoi_assert(condType->type == IRValueType::valueType::booleanObject,
2119 forStmt->getLine(),
2120 forStmt->getColumn(),
2121 "The type in for-condition must be boolean");
2122
2123 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpIfOp(IR::Opcode::jump_if_true, codeBlock);
2124 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpOp(outBlock);
2125 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(codeBlock);
2126 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().pushLoopContext(outBlock, condBlock);
2127 visit(forStmt->block, true);
2128 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().popLoopContext();
2129
2130 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpOp(afterBlock);
2131 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(afterBlock);
2132 visit(forStmt->afterStmt);
2133
2134 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().jumpOp(condBlock);
2135 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(outBlock);
2136
2137 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().irFuncDefinition()->getVariableTable().popScope();
2138
2139 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
2140 }

2171 IRValueType visitor::parseTypeSpec(yoi::identifierWithTemplateArg *identifierWithTemplateArg) {
2172 if (identifierWithTemplateArg->hasTemplateArg()) {
2173 auto baseName = identifierWithTemplateArg->getId().node.strVal;
2174 auto concreteTypes = parseTemplateArgs(identifierWithTemplateArg->getArg());
2175
2176 if (irModule->structTemplateAsts.contains(baseName)) {
2177 try {
2178 auto pureTemplateAst = irModule->templateImplAsts.at(baseName);
2179 auto specializedIndex = specializeStructTemplate(baseName, concreteTypes, pureTemplateAst, currentModuleIndex);
2180 return {IRValueType::valueType::structObject, currentModuleIndex, specializedIndex};
2181 } catch (std::out_of_range &e) {
2182 panic(identifierWithTemplateArg->getLine(),
2183 identifierWithTemplateArg->getColumn(),
2184 "No implementation block found for struct template: " + wstring2string(baseName));
2185 }
2186 } else if (irModule->templateInterfaceAsts.contains(baseName)) {
2187 auto specializedIndex = specializeInterfaceTemplate(baseName, concreteTypes, currentModuleIndex);
2188 return {IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject, currentModuleIndex, specializedIndex};
2189 } else {
2190 panic(identifierWithTemplateArg->getLine(),
2191 identifierWithTemplateArg->getColumn(),
2192 "Unknown template: " + wstring2string(baseName));
2193 }
2194 } else {
2195 return parseTypeSpec(identifierWithTemplateArg->id);
2196 }
2197 }
2198
2199 IRValueType visitor::parseTypeSpec(yoi::subscriptExpr *subscriptExpr) {
2200 if (!subscriptExpr->getSubscript().empty()) {
2201 // This is an array type like `int[10]`
2202 auto baseType = parseTypeSpec(subscriptExpr->id);
2203 yoi::vec<yoi::indexT> dimensions;
2204 for (auto &sub : subscriptExpr->getSubscript()) {
2205 yoi_assert(
2206 sub->isSubscript() && sub->expr->getToken().kind == lexer::token::tokenKind::integer, sub->getLine(), sub->getColumn(), "Expected dimension size for array type.");
2207 dimensions.push_back(sub->expr->getToken().basicVal.vInt);
2208 }
2209 return baseType.getArrayType(dimensions);
2210 } else {
2211 return parseTypeSpec(subscriptExpr->id);
2212 }
2213 }

2215 IRValueType visitor::parseTypeSpecExtern(yoi::identifier *identifier, yoi::indexT targetModule) {
2216 auto mod = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(targetModule);
2217 if (auto it = mod->typeAliases.find(identifier->get().strVal); it != mod->typeAliases.end()) {
2218 return it->second;
2219 }
2220 auto ex = getExternEntry(targetModule, identifier->node.strVal);
2221 if (ex.type == IRExternEntry::externType::structType)
2222 return {IRValueType::valueType::structObject, ex.affiliateModule, ex.itemIndex};
2223 else if (ex.type == IRExternEntry::externType::interfaceType)
2224 return {IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject, ex.affiliateModule, ex.itemIndex};
2225 else
2226 panic(identifier->getLine(), identifier->getColumn(), "Unsupported extern type: " + wstring2string(identifier->node.strVal));
2227 }
2228
2229 IRValueType visitor::parseTypeSpecExtern(yoi::identifierWithTemplateArg *identifierWithTemplateArg,
2230 yoi::indexT targetModule) {
2231 if (identifierWithTemplateArg->hasTemplateArg()) {
2232 auto targetedModule = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(targetModule);
2233
2234 auto baseName = identifierWithTemplateArg->getId().node.strVal;
2235 auto concreteTypes = parseTemplateArgs(identifierWithTemplateArg->getArg());
2236
2237 if (targetedModule->structTemplateAsts.contains(baseName)) {
2238 try {
2239 auto pureTemplateAst = targetedModule->templateImplAsts.at(baseName);
2240 auto specializedIndex = specializeStructTemplate(baseName, concreteTypes, pureTemplateAst, targetModule);
2241 return {IRValueType::valueType::structObject, targetModule, specializedIndex};
2242 } catch (std::out_of_range &e) {
2243 panic(identifierWithTemplateArg->getLine(),
2244 identifierWithTemplateArg->getColumn(),
2245 "No implementation block found for struct template: " + wstring2string(baseName));
2246 }
2247 } else if (targetedModule->templateInterfaceAsts.contains(baseName)) {
2248 auto specializedIndex = specializeInterfaceTemplate(baseName, concreteTypes, targetModule);
2249 return {IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject, targetModule, specializedIndex};
2250 } else {
2251 panic(identifierWithTemplateArg->getLine(),
2252 identifierWithTemplateArg->getColumn(),
2253 "Unknown template: " + wstring2string(baseName));
2254 }
2255 } else {
2256 return parseTypeSpecExtern(identifierWithTemplateArg->id, targetModule);
2257 }
2258 }
2259
2260 IRValueType visitor::parseTypeSpecExtern(yoi::subscriptExpr *subscriptExpr, yoi::indexT targetModule) {
2261 if (!subscriptExpr->getSubscript().empty()) {
2262 auto baseType = parseTypeSpecExtern(subscriptExpr->id, targetModule);
2263 // TODO: Create and return an extern array type, creating extern entries for dimensions if necessary.
2264 panic(subscriptExpr->getLine(),
2265 subscriptExpr->getColumn(),
2266 "TODO: Extern array type parsing not fully implemented.");
2267 return {IRValueType::valueType::null};
2268 } else {
2269 return parseTypeSpecExtern(subscriptExpr->id, targetModule);
2270 }
2271 }
2272
2273 IRValueType visitor::parseTypeSpec(yoi::typeSpec *typeSpec) {
2274 switch (typeSpec->kind) {
2275 case 0: {
2276 // member
2277 auto it = typeSpec->member->getTerms().begin();
2278 yoi::indexT targetModule = -1, lastModule = -1;
2279 while (it + 1 != typeSpec->member->getTerms().end() &&
2280 (targetModule = isModuleName(*it, targetModule)) != lastModule) {
2281 it++;
2282 lastModule = targetModule;
2283 }
2284
2285 IRValueType lhs{IRValueType::valueType::integerObject};
2286 if (targetModule == -1) {
2287 lhs = parseTypeSpec(*it);
2288 } else {
2289 lhs = parseTypeSpecExtern(*it, targetModule);
2290 }
2291 yoi_assert(it + 1 == typeSpec->member->getTerms().end(),
2292 typeSpec->getLine(),
2293 typeSpec->getColumn(),
2294 "Type specifier is not valid.");
2295
2296 return typeSpec->hasArrayTypeSpec ? lhs.getDynamicArrayType() : lhs;
2297 }
2298 case 1: {
2299 // func
2300 return parseTypeSpec(typeSpec->func);
2301 }
2302 case 2: {
2303 // null
2304 return {IRValueType::valueType::null};
2305 }
2306 case 3: {
2307 // elipsis
2308 // let it fallback to invalid
2309 }
2310 default: {
2311 panic(typeSpec->getLine(), typeSpec->getColumn(), "Type specifier is not valid.");
2312 return {IRValueType::valueType::null};
2313 }
2314 }
2315 }
2316
2317 yoi::wstr visitor::parseIdentifierWithTemplateArg(yoi::identifierWithTemplateArg *identifierWithTemplateArg) {
2318 yoi::wstr res = identifierWithTemplateArg->getId().node.strVal;
2319 if (identifierWithTemplateArg->hasTemplateArg()) {
2320 res += L"<";
2321 for (auto &i : identifierWithTemplateArg->getArg().get()) {
2322 res += parseTypeSpec(i->spec).to_string();
2323 res += L",";
2324 }
2325 res.pop_back();
2326 res += L">";
2327 }
2328 return std::move(res);
2329 }

2337 std::pair<std::pair<yoi::indexT, yoi::indexT>, std::shared_ptr<IRInterfaceInstanceDefinition>>
2338 visitor::parseInterfaceName(yoi::externModuleAccessExpression *structDef) {
2339 // modules~
2340 auto it = structDef->getTerms().begin();
2341 yoi::indexT targetModule = -1, lastModule = -1;
2342 while (it + 1 != structDef->getTerms().end() && (targetModule = isModuleName(*it, targetModule)) != lastModule) {
2343 it++;
2344 lastModule = targetModule;
2345 }
2346 if (targetModule == -1) {
2347 targetModule = currentModuleIndex;
2348 }
2349 yoi_assert(it + 1 == structDef->getTerms().end(),
2350 structDef->getLine(),
2351 structDef->getColumn(),
2352 "Invalid interface name");
2353 auto interfaceName = parseIdentifierWithTemplateArg(*it);
2354 try {
2355 auto target = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(targetModule);
2356 auto interfaceIndex = target->interfaceTable.getIndex(interfaceName);
2357 return std::make_pair(std::make_pair(targetModule, interfaceIndex), target->interfaceTable[interfaceIndex]);
2358 } catch (std::out_of_range &) {
2359 panic(
2360 structDef->getLine(), structDef->getColumn(), "Undefined interface: " + wstring2string(interfaceName));
2361 }
2362 }

2372 yoi::IRExternEntry visitor::getExternEntry(yoi::indexT moduleIndex, const yoi::wstr &identifier) const {
2373 try {
2374 auto res = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()
2375 ->getImportedModule(moduleIndex)
2376 ->globalVariables.getIndex(identifier);
2377 return {IRExternEntry::externType::globalVar, identifier, moduleIndex, res};
2378 } catch (std::out_of_range &) {
2379 }
2380 try {
2381 auto res =
2382 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(moduleIndex)->functionTable.getIndex(identifier);
2383 return {IRExternEntry::externType::function, identifier, moduleIndex, res};
2384 } catch (std::out_of_range &) {
2385 }
2386 try {
2387 auto res =
2388 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(moduleIndex)->structTable.getIndex(identifier);
2389 return {IRExternEntry::externType::structType, identifier, moduleIndex, res};
2390 } catch (std::out_of_range &) {
2391 }
2392 try {
2393 auto res = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()
2394 ->getImportedModule(moduleIndex)
2395 ->interfaceTable.getIndex(identifier);
2396 return {IRExternEntry::externType::interfaceType, identifier, moduleIndex, res};
2397 } catch (std::out_of_range &) {
2398 }
2399 try {
2400 auto res = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()
2401 ->getImportedModule(moduleIndex)
2402 ->interfaceImplementationTable.getIndex(identifier);
2403 return {IRExternEntry::externType::interfaceImplType, identifier, moduleIndex, res};
2404 } catch (std::out_of_range &) {
2405 }
2406
2407 throw std::out_of_range("undefined identifier: not known global variable, function, struct or interface type: " + yoi::wstring2string(identifier));
2408 }

2410 yoi::indexT visitor::addExternEntryIfNotExists(yoi::indexT moduleIndex, const yoi::wstr &identifier) {
2411 // extern entry format: moduleIndex#identifier
2412 yoi::wstr key = std::to_wstring(moduleIndex) + L"#" + identifier;
2413 try {
2414 auto it = irModule->externTable.getIndex(key);
2415 return it;
2416 } catch (std::runtime_error &) {
2417 // not found, add a new entry
2418 return irModule->externTable.put(key, managedPtr(getExternEntry(moduleIndex, identifier)));
2419 }
2420 }

2426 void visitor::emitBasicCastInBasicArithOpByLhsAndRhs(yoi::indexT lhs, yoi::indexT rhs) {
2427 auto &lhsType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getLhsFromTempVarStack();
2428 auto &rhsType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
2429
2430 if (lhsType->isForeignBasicType()) {
2431 lhsType = managedPtr(lhsType->getNormalizedForeignBasicType());
2432 }
2433 if (rhsType->isForeignBasicType()) {
2434 rhsType = managedPtr(rhsType->getNormalizedForeignBasicType());
2435 }
2436
2437 // if bool and char with other, upcast to other
2438 if (lhsType->is1ByteType() && !rhsType->is1ByteType()) {
2439 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(rhsType, lhs, true);
2440 } else if (!lhsType->is1ByteType() && rhsType->is1ByteType()) {
2441 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(lhsType, rhs);
2442 }
2443 // if short with other, upcast to other
2444 if (lhsType->type == IRValueType::valueType::shortObject && rhsType->type != IRValueType::valueType::shortObject) {
2445 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(rhsType, lhs, true);
2446 } else if (lhsType->type != IRValueType::valueType::shortObject && rhsType->type == IRValueType::valueType::shortObject) {
2447 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(lhsType, rhs);
2448 }
2449 // if int with deci, upcast to deci
2450 else if (lhsType->type == IRValueType::valueType::integerObject &&
2451 rhsType->type == IRValueType::valueType::decimalObject) {
2452 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(rhsType, lhs, true);
2453 } else if (lhsType->type == IRValueType::valueType::decimalObject &&
2454 rhsType->type == IRValueType::valueType::integerObject) {
2455 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(lhsType, rhs);
2456 }
2457 // if unsigned with int, upcast to int
2458 else if (lhsType->type == IRValueType::valueType::unsignedObject && rhsType->type == IRValueType::valueType::integerObject) {
2459 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(rhsType, lhs, true);
2460 } else if (lhsType->type == IRValueType::valueType::integerObject &&
2461 rhsType->type == IRValueType::valueType::unsignedObject) {
2462 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(lhsType, rhs);
2463 }
2464 // if unsigned with deci, upcast to deci
2465 else if (lhsType->type == IRValueType::valueType::unsignedObject &&
2466 rhsType->type == IRValueType::valueType::decimalObject) {
2467 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(rhsType, lhs, true);
2468 } else if (lhsType->type == IRValueType::valueType::decimalObject &&
2469 rhsType->type == IRValueType::valueType::unsignedObject) {
2470 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(lhsType, rhs);
2471 }
2472 // if left or right is pointer, cast the other to pointer
2473 else if (lhsType->type == IRValueType::valueType::pointerObject) {
2474 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(lhsType, rhs);
2475 } else if (rhsType->type == IRValueType::valueType::pointerObject) {
2476 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(rhsType, lhs, true);
2477 }
2478 }

2480 void visitor::emitBasicCastTo(const std::shared_ptr<IRValueType> &toType) {
2481 auto rhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
2482
2483 if (rhs->type == toType->type) {
2484 return;
2485 } else {
2486 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().basicCast(toType, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint());
2487 }
2488 }

2494 yoi::wstr visitor::getTypeSpecUniqueNameStr(const std::shared_ptr<IRValueType> &type) {
2495 yoi::wstr res;
2496 switch (type->type) {
2497 case IRValueType::valueType::integerObject:
2498 res = L"int";
2499 break;
2500 case IRValueType::valueType::decimalObject:
2501 res = L"deci";
2502 break;
2503 case IRValueType::valueType::booleanObject:
2504 res = L"bool";
2505 break;
2506 case IRValueType::valueType::stringObject:
2507 res = L"str";
2508 break;
2509 case IRValueType::valueType::characterObject:
2510 res = L"char";
2511 break;
2512 case IRValueType::valueType::shortObject:
2513 res = L"short";
2514 break;
2515 case IRValueType::valueType::unsignedObject:
2516 res = L"unsigned";
2517 break;
2518 case IRValueType::valueType::structObject:
2519 res = L"struct#" + std::to_wstring(type->typeAffiliateModule) + L"#" + std::to_wstring(type->typeIndex);
2520 break;
2521 case IRValueType::valueType::null:
2522 res = L"null";
2523 break;
2524 case IRValueType::valueType::virtualMethod:
2525 res = L"virtual_method#" + std::to_wstring(type->typeAffiliateModule) + L"#" +
2526 std::to_wstring(type->typeIndex);
2527 break;
2528 case IRValueType::valueType::incompleteTemplateType:
2529 res = L"incomplete_template_type#" + std::to_wstring(type->typeIndex);
2530 break;
2531 case IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject:
2532 res = L"interfaceObject#" + std::to_wstring(type->typeAffiliateModule) + L"#" + std::to_wstring(type->typeIndex);
2533 break;
2534 case IRValueType::valueType::pointerObject:
2535 res = L"pointerObject";
2536 break;
2537 case IRValueType::valueType::none:
2538 res = L"none";
2539 break;
2540 default:
2541 panic(moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().line, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().column, "Invalid type");
2542 break;
2543 }
2544 if (type->isArrayType()) {
2545 yoi::indexT arraySize = 1;
2546 for (auto &dim : type->dimensions) {
2547 arraySize *= dim;
2548 }
2549 res += L"[" + std::to_wstring(arraySize) + L"]";
2550 } else if (type->isDynamicArrayType()) {
2551 res += L"[]";
2552 }
2553 return res;
2554 }
2555
2556 yoi::wstr visitor::getFuncUniqueNameStr(const std::vector<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> &argumentTypes,
2557 bool whetherIgnoreFirstParam) {
2558 yoi::wstr res = L"#";
2559 bool first = false;
2560 for (auto &arg : argumentTypes) {
2561 if (whetherIgnoreFirstParam && !first || !whetherIgnoreFirstParam)
2562 res += getTypeSpecUniqueNameStr(arg) + L"#";
2563 else
2564 first = false;
2565 }
2566 if (!argumentTypes.empty()) {
2567 res.pop_back();
2568 }
2569 res.shrink_to_fit();
2570 return res;
2571 }

2573 yoi::indexT visitor::visitExtern(yoi::identifier *identifier, yoi::indexT targetModule, bool isStoreOp) {
2574 try {
2575 yoi::IRExternEntry entry = getExternEntry(targetModule, identifier->get().strVal);
2576 yoi_assert(entry.type == IRExternEntry::externType::globalVar,
2577 identifier->getLine(),
2578 identifier->getColumn(),
2579 "Invalid type specifier, expected global variable");
2580 auto valType = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()
2581 ->getImportedModule(targetModule)
2582 ->globalVariables[identifier->node.strVal];
2583 if (isStoreOp) {
2584 tryCastTo(valType);
2585 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().storeOp(
2586 IR::Opcode::store_global, {IROperand::operandType::externVar, entry.itemIndex}, entry.affiliateModule);
2587 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
2588 } else {
2589 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().loadOp(
2590 IR::Opcode::load_global, {IROperand::operandType::externVar, entry.itemIndex}, valType, entry.affiliateModule);
2591 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
2592 }
2593 } catch (std::runtime_error &) {
2594 // not found, panic
2595 panic(identifier->getLine(),
2596 identifier->getColumn(),
2597 "undefined identifier: " + wstring2string(identifier->node.strVal));
2598 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
2599 }
2600 }

2625 yoi::indexTable<yoi::wstr, IRTemplateBuilder::Argument>
2626 visitor::getTemplateArgs(const yoi::defTemplateArg &templateArgs) {
2627 yoi::indexTable<yoi::wstr, IRTemplateBuilder::Argument> res;
2628 for (auto &arg : templateArgs.spec) {
2629 yoi::wstr name = arg->getId().get().strVal;
2630 auto index = res.put_create(name, {{}, {-1, -1}});
2631 res[index].templateType =
2632 managedPtr(IRValueType{IRValueType::valueType::incompleteTemplateType, currentModuleIndex, index});
2633
2634 if (arg->impl) {
2635 auto constraint = parseInterfaceName(arg->impl);
2636 res[index].interfaceType = constraint.first;

2638 }
2639 return res;

2649
2650 yoi::indexT
2651 visitor::specializeFunctionTemplate(yoi::funcDefStmt *astNode,
2652 const yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> &concreteTemplateArgs,
2653 yoi::indexT moduleIndex) {
2654 auto targetedModule = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(moduleIndex);
2655
2656 yoi::wstr specializedName =
2657 getMangledTemplateName(astNode->id->id->get().strVal, concreteTemplateArgs);
2658
2659 if (targetedModule->functionTable.contains(specializedName)) {
2660 return targetedModule->functionTable.getIndex(specializedName);
2661 }
2662
2663 // Create a new function definition by specializing the template
2664 IRFunctionDefinition::Builder builder;
2665
2666 builder.setDebugInfo({targetedModule->modulePath, astNode->getLine(), astNode->getColumn()});
2667
2668 // Create specialization context
2669 IRTemplateBuilder specializationContext;
2670 for (yoi::indexT i = 0; i < astNode->id->arg->get().size(); ++i) {
2671 auto paramName = astNode->id->arg->get()[i]->id->get().strVal;
2672 specializationContext.addTemplateArgument(paramName, concreteTemplateArgs[i]);
2673 }
2674
2675
2676 pushModuleContext(moduleIndex);
2677 moduleContext->pushTemplateBuilder(specializationContext);
2678
2679 // Specialize arguments and return type
2680 yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> paramTypes;
2681 for (const auto &argPair : astNode->getArgs().get()) {
2682 auto argName = argPair->getId().get().strVal;
2683 auto argType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(&argPair->getSpec()));
2684 builder.addArgument(argName, argType);
2685 paramTypes.push_back(argType);
2686 }
2687 builder.setName(specializedName + getFuncUniqueNameStr(paramTypes));
2688 builder.setReturnType(managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(&astNode->getResultType())));
2689
2690 auto specializedFunc = builder.yield();
2691 auto funcIndex = targetedModule->functionTable.put_create(specializedName + getFuncUniqueNameStr(paramTypes), specializedFunc);
2692 targetedModule->functionOverloadIndexies[specializedName].push_back(funcIndex);
2693
2694 // Visit the body to generate IR
2695 moduleContext->pushIRBuilder({moduleContext->getCompilerContext(), targetedModule, specializedFunc});
2696 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().setDebugInfo({targetedModule->modulePath, astNode->getLine(), astNode->getColumn()});
2697 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock());
2698 visit(&astNode->getBlock(), true);
2699 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().yield();
2700 moduleContext->popIRBuilder();
2701
2702 // Pop context
2703 moduleContext->popTemplateBuilder();
2704 popModuleContext();
2705
2706 return funcIndex;
2707 }
2708
2709 yoi::wstr visitor::getMangledTemplateName(const yoi::wstr &baseName,
2710 const yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> &templateArgs) {
2711 yoi::wstr mangled = baseName + L"<";
2712 for (size_t i = 0; i < templateArgs.size(); ++i) {
2713 mangled += getTypeSpecUniqueNameStr(templateArgs[i]);
2714 if (i < templateArgs.size() - 1) {
2715 mangled += L",";
2716 }
2717 }
2718 mangled += L">";
2719 return mangled;
2720 }
2721
2722 yoi::indexT visitor::specializeStructTemplate(const yoi::wstr &templateName,
2723 const yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> &concreteTemplateArgs,
2724 yoi::implStmt *pureTemplateImplAst, yoi::indexT moduleIndex) {
2725
2726 auto targetedModule = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(moduleIndex);
2727
2728 yoi::wstr specializedName = getMangledTemplateName(templateName, concreteTemplateArgs);
2729
2730 if (targetedModule->structTable.contains(specializedName)) {
2731 return targetedModule->structTable.getIndex(specializedName);
2732 }
2733
2734 auto structAst = targetedModule->structTemplateAsts.at(templateName);
2735
2736 IRTemplateBuilder specializationContext;
2737 yoi_assert(concreteTemplateArgs.size() == structAst->id->getArg().get().size(),
2738 0, 0, "Template argument count mismatch for struct " + wstring2string(templateName));
2739 for (yoi::indexT i = 0; i < concreteTemplateArgs.size(); ++i) {
2740 auto paramName = structAst->id->getArg().get()[i]->getId().get().strVal;
2741 specializationContext.addTemplateArgument(paramName, concreteTemplateArgs[i]);
2742 }
2743
2744 auto specializedStructIndex = targetedModule->structTable.put_create(specializedName, nullptr);
2745
2746 generateNullInterfaceImplementation(managedPtr(IRValueType{IRValueType::valueType::structObject, moduleIndex, specializedStructIndex}));
2747 auto selfType = managedPtr(IRValueType{IRValueType::valueType::structObject, moduleIndex, specializedStructIndex});
2748 specializationContext.addTemplateArgument(L"STRUCT", selfType);
2749
2750 pushModuleContext(moduleIndex);
2751 moduleContext->pushTemplateBuilder(specializationContext);
2752
2753 IRStructDefinition::Builder builder;
2754 builder.setName(specializedName);
2755 for (auto &field : structAst->getInner().getInner()) {
2756 if (field->kind == 0) {
2757 auto memberName = field->getVar().getId().get().strVal;
2758 auto memberType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(field->getVar().spec));
2759 builder.addField(memberName, memberType);
2760 } else {
2761 auto [funcIndex, funcName] = specializeStructMethodDeclaration(specializationContext, field, specializedName, concreteTemplateArgs, moduleIndex);
2762 builder.addMethod(funcName, funcIndex);
2763 }
2764 }
2765
2766 auto specializedStruct = builder.yield();
2767 targetedModule->structTable[specializedStructIndex] = specializedStruct;
2768
2769 // Specialize methods defined in `impl MyStruct<T> { ... }`
2770 if (pureTemplateImplAst) {
2771 for (auto &methodAst : pureTemplateImplAst->getInner().getInner()) {
2772 specializeStructMethodDefinition(specializationContext, specializedStruct, methodAst, specializedName, concreteTemplateArgs, moduleIndex);
2773 }
2774 }
2775
2776 if (targetedModule->templateInterfaceImplAsts.count(templateName)) {
2777 for (auto& implAst : targetedModule->templateInterfaceImplAsts.at(templateName)) {
2778 specializeInterfaceImplementation(implAst, selfType, specializedName, concreteTemplateArgs, currentModuleIndex); // now we are in the specialized context
2779 }
2780 }
2781
2782 moduleContext->popTemplateBuilder();
2783 popModuleContext();
2784
2785 return specializedStructIndex;
2786 }
2787
2788 std::pair<yoi::indexT, yoi::wstr> visitor::specializeStructMethodDeclaration(IRTemplateBuilder &structTemplate,
2789 yoi::structDefInnerPair *methodAstNode,
2790 const yoi::wstr &specializedStructName,
2791 const yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> &concreteTemplateArgs,
2792 yoi::indexT moduleIndex) {
2793
2794 auto targetedModule = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(moduleIndex);
2795
2796 // Push the template's own context to resolve generic types like 'T' to their placeholder
2797 // 'incompleteTemplateType'.
2798 IRTemplateBuilder genericContext;
2799 genericContext.templateArguments = structTemplate.templateArguments;
2800
2801 moduleContext->pushTemplateBuilder(genericContext);
2802
2803 yoi::wstr baseMethodName;
2804 yoi::wstr genericMethodKey;
2805 yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> genericArgTypes;
2806
2807 if (methodAstNode->kind == 1) {
2808 baseMethodName = L"constructor";
2809 for (auto &arg : methodAstNode->getConstructor().getArgs().get()) {
2810 genericArgTypes.push_back(managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(&arg->getSpec())));
2811 }
2812 genericMethodKey = baseMethodName + getFuncUniqueNameStr(genericArgTypes);
2813 } else if (methodAstNode->kind == 2) {
2814 baseMethodName = methodAstNode->getMethod().getName().get().strVal;
2815 for (auto &arg : methodAstNode->getMethod().getArgs().get()) {
2816 genericArgTypes.push_back(managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(&arg->getSpec())));
2817 }
2818 genericMethodKey = baseMethodName + getFuncUniqueNameStr(genericArgTypes);
2819 }
2820
2821 moduleContext->popTemplateBuilder(); // Done with generic context
2822
2823 IRTemplateBuilder specializationContext;
2824 for (size_t i = 0; i < concreteTemplateArgs.size(); ++i) {
2825 auto paramName = structTemplate.templateArguments.getKey(i);
2826 specializationContext.addTemplateArgument(paramName, concreteTemplateArgs[i]);
2827 }
2828 auto selfType = managedPtr(IRValueType{IRValueType::valueType::structObject,
2829 moduleIndex,
2830 targetedModule->structTable.getIndex(specializedStructName)});
2831 specializationContext.addTemplateArgument(L"STRUCT", selfType);
2832 moduleContext->pushTemplateBuilder(specializationContext);
2833
2834 IRFunctionDefinition::Builder funcBuilder;
2835
2836 funcBuilder.setDebugInfo({targetedModule->modulePath, methodAstNode->getLine(), methodAstNode->getColumn()});
2837
2838 yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> specializedArgTypes;
2839
2840 if (methodAstNode->kind == 1) {
2841 funcBuilder.addAttr(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Constructor);
2842 funcBuilder.addArgument(L"this", selfType); // Specialized 'this'
2843 for (auto &arg : methodAstNode->getConstructor().getArgs().get()) {
2844 auto specializedType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(&arg->getSpec()));
2845 funcBuilder.addArgument(arg->getId().get().strVal, specializedType);
2846 specializedArgTypes.push_back(specializedType);
2847 }
2848 funcBuilder.setReturnType(selfType);
2849 } else if (methodAstNode->kind == 2) {
2850 funcBuilder.attrs = getFunctionAttributes(methodAstNode->getMethod().attrs);
2851 if (std::find(funcBuilder.attrs.begin(), funcBuilder.attrs.end(), IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Static) == funcBuilder.attrs.end()) {
2852 funcBuilder.addArgument(L"this", selfType); // Specialized 'this'
2853 }
2854 for (auto &arg : methodAstNode->getMethod().getArgs().get()) {
2855 auto specializedType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(&arg->getSpec()));
2856 funcBuilder.addArgument(arg->getId().get().strVal, specializedType);
2857 specializedArgTypes.push_back(specializedType);
2858 }
2859 funcBuilder.setReturnType(managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(&methodAstNode->getMethod().getResultType())));
2860 }
2861
2862 yoi::wstr specializedMethodName =
2863 specializedStructName + L"::" + baseMethodName;
2864 funcBuilder.setName(specializedMethodName + getFuncUniqueNameStr(specializedArgTypes));
2865
2866 auto specializedFunc = funcBuilder.yield();
2867 auto funcIndex = targetedModule->functionTable.put_create(specializedMethodName + getFuncUniqueNameStr(specializedArgTypes), specializedFunc);
2868 targetedModule->functionOverloadIndexies[specializedMethodName].push_back(funcIndex);
2869
2870 moduleContext->popTemplateBuilder();
2871 return {funcIndex, baseMethodName + getFuncUniqueNameStr(specializedArgTypes)};
2872 }

2874 void visitor::specializeStructMethodDefinition(IRTemplateBuilder &structTemplate,
2875 const std::shared_ptr<IRStructDefinition> &specializedStruct,
2876 yoi::implInnerPair *methodAstNode,
2877 const yoi::wstr &specializedStructName,
2878 const yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> &concreteTemplateArgs,
2879 yoi::indexT moduleIndex) {
2880
2881 auto targetedModule = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(moduleIndex);
2882
2883 // Push the template's own context to resolve generic types like 'T' to their placeholder
2884 // 'incompleteTemplateType'.
2885 IRTemplateBuilder genericContext;
2886 genericContext.templateArguments = structTemplate.templateArguments;
2887
2888 moduleContext->pushTemplateBuilder(genericContext);
2889
2890 yoi::wstr baseMethodName;
2891 yoi::wstr genericMethodKey;
2892 yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> genericArgTypes;
2893
2894 if (methodAstNode->isConstructor()) {
2895 baseMethodName = L"constructor";
2896 for (auto &arg : methodAstNode->getConstructor().getArgs().get()) {
2897 genericArgTypes.push_back(managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(&arg->getSpec())));
2898 }
2899 genericMethodKey = baseMethodName + getFuncUniqueNameStr(genericArgTypes);
2900 } else {
2901 baseMethodName = methodAstNode->getMethod().getName().get().strVal;
2902 for (auto &arg : methodAstNode->getMethod().getArgs().get()) {
2903 genericArgTypes.push_back(managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(&arg->getSpec())));
2904 }
2905 genericMethodKey = baseMethodName + getFuncUniqueNameStr(genericArgTypes);
2906 }
2907
2908 moduleContext->popTemplateBuilder(); // Done with generic context
2909
2910 IRTemplateBuilder specializationContext;
2911 for (size_t i = 0; i < concreteTemplateArgs.size(); ++i) {
2912 auto paramName = structTemplate.templateArguments.getKey(i);
2913 specializationContext.addTemplateArgument(paramName, concreteTemplateArgs[i]);
2914 }
2915 auto selfType = managedPtr(IRValueType{IRValueType::valueType::structObject,
2916 moduleIndex,
2917 targetedModule->structTable.getIndex(specializedStructName)});
2918 specializationContext.addTemplateArgument(L"STRUCT", selfType);
2919 moduleContext->pushTemplateBuilder(specializationContext);
2920
2921 yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> specializedArgTypes;
2922
2923 if (methodAstNode->isConstructor()) {
2924 for (auto &arg : methodAstNode->getConstructor().getArgs().get()) {
2925 auto specializedType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(&arg->getSpec()));
2926 specializedArgTypes.push_back(specializedType);
2927 }
2928 } else {
2929 for (auto &arg : methodAstNode->getMethod().getArgs().get()) {
2930 auto specializedType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(&arg->getSpec()));
2931 specializedArgTypes.push_back(specializedType);
2932 }
2933 }
2934
2935 yoi::wstr specializedMethodName =
2936 specializedStructName + L"::" + baseMethodName + getFuncUniqueNameStr(specializedArgTypes);
2937
2938 auto funcIndex = targetedModule->functionTable.getIndex(specializedMethodName);
2939
2940 moduleContext->pushIRBuilder({moduleContext->getCompilerContext(), targetedModule, targetedModule->functionTable[funcIndex]});
2941 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().setDebugInfo({targetedModule->modulePath, methodAstNode->getLine(), methodAstNode->getColumn()});
2942 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock());
2943 try {
2944 visit(methodAstNode->isConstructor() ? &methodAstNode->getConstructor().getBlock()
2945 : &methodAstNode->getMethod().getBlock(),
2946 true);
2947 } catch (std::exception &e) {
2948 set_current_file_path(moduleContextStack.top().first->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().sourceFile);
2949 panic(moduleContextStack.top().first->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().line, moduleContextStack.top().first->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().column, std::string("Exception occurred while specializing method: ") + yoi::wstring2string(specializedMethodName) + ": " + e.what() + "\n");
2950 }
2951
2952 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().yield();
2953 moduleContext->popIRBuilder();
2954 moduleContext->popTemplateBuilder();
2955 }

2957 yoi::wstr
2958 visitor::getSpecializedMangledMethodName(yoi::indexTable<yoi::wstr, IRTemplateBuilder::Argument> &templateArgs,
2959 const yoi::wstr &baseMethodName,
2960 const yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> &specializedArgTypes) {
2961 auto res = baseMethodName;
2962 for (yoi::indexT i = 0; i < specializedArgTypes.size(); ++i) {
2963 auto &arg = templateArgs[i];
2964 auto strRepl1 = templateArgs[i].templateType->to_string();
2965 auto strRepl2 = specializedArgTypes[i]->to_string();
2966 replace_all(res, strRepl1, strRepl2);
2967 }
2968 return res;

2970
2971 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::exportDecl *exportDecl) {
2972 auto exportIdentifier = exportDecl->as->node.strVal;
2973 try {
2974 auto parsedType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(exportDecl->from));
2975
2976 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getIRFFITable()->addForeignType(exportIdentifier, parsedType);
2977 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
2978 } catch (std::runtime_error &e) {
2979 // failed as type, try function
2980 }
2981
2982 try {
2983 auto it = exportDecl->from->member->getTerms().begin();
2984 yoi::indexT targetModule = -1, lastModule = -1;
2985 while (it + 1 != exportDecl->from->member->getTerms().end() &&
2986 (targetModule = isModuleName(*it, targetModule)) != lastModule) {
2987 it++;
2988 lastModule = targetModule;
2989 }
2990 yoi_assert(it + 1 == exportDecl->from->member->getTerms().end(),
2991 exportDecl->getLine(),
2992 exportDecl->getColumn(),
2993 "Expected a identifier after modules but this is not the final term of expression.");
2994 targetModule = targetModule == -1 ? currentModuleIndex : targetModule;
2995
2996 yoi::indexT funcIndex = -1;
2997
2998 if (!(*it)->hasTemplateArg()) {
2999 for (auto funcIt =
3000 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(targetModule)->functionTable.begin();
3001 funcIt !=
3002 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(targetModule)->functionTable.end();
3003 funcIt++) {
3004 if (funcIt->first.starts_with((*it)->id->get().strVal + L"#")) {
3005 // an mangled name of target function
3006 funcIndex = std::distance(
3007 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(targetModule)->functionTable.begin(),
3008 funcIt);
3009 }
3010 }
3011 }
3012
3013 if (funcIndex != -1) {
3014 auto attrs = getFunctionAttributes(exportDecl->attrs);
3015 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getIRFFITable()->addExportedFunction(
3016 exportIdentifier, targetModule, funcIndex, attrs);
3017 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
3018 } else {
3019 // try template
3020 auto templateName = (*it)->id->get().strVal;
3021 if (!moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(targetModule)->funcTemplateAsts.contains(templateName)) {
3022 throw std::out_of_range("Cannot find the template: " + wstring2string(templateName));
3023 }
3024
3025 yoi_assert((*it)->hasTemplateArg(),
3026 exportDecl->getLine(),
3027 exportDecl->getColumn(),
3028 "Expected template arguments for template: " + wstring2string(templateName));
3029
3030 auto templateArgs = parseTemplateArgs((*it)->getArg());
3031
3032 auto funcIndex = specializeFunctionTemplate(moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(targetModule)->funcTemplateAsts[templateName],templateArgs, targetModule);
3033
3034 auto attrs = getFunctionAttributes(exportDecl->attrs);
3035
3036 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getIRFFITable()->addExportedFunction(
3037 exportIdentifier, targetModule, funcIndex, attrs);
3038 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
3039 }
3040 } catch (std::out_of_range &e) {
3041 panic(exportDecl->getLine(),
3042 exportDecl->getColumn(),
3043 "None of the existing types and functions match the name: " +
3044 wstring2string(exportDecl->as->node.strVal));
3045 }
3046 }
3047
3048 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::importDecl *importDecl) {
3049 yoi::wstr from{};
3050
3051 if (importDecl->from_path.strVal == L"builtin") {
3052 from = L"builtin";
3053 } else {
3054 for (auto &prep : moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getBuildConfig()->searchPaths) {
3055 try {
3056 std::filesystem::path final = std::filesystem::path(prep) / importDecl->from_path.strVal;
3057 from = realpath(final.wstring());
3058 break;
3059 } catch (std::runtime_error &e) {
3060 continue;
3061 }
3062 }
3063 }
3064 yoi_assert(!from.empty(),
3065 importDecl->getLine(),
3066 importDecl->getColumn(),
3067 "Cannot find the file: " + wstring2string(importDecl->from_path.strVal));
3068
3069 // import method implementation
3070 // parse method signature and add to import table
3071 auto funcName = importDecl->inner->name->get().strVal;
3072 IRFunctionDefinition::Builder builder;
3073
3074 builder.attrs = getFunctionAttributes(importDecl->inner->attrs);
3075 builder.setDebugInfo({irModule->modulePath, importDecl->inner->getLine(), importDecl->inner->getColumn()});
3076
3077 builder.setReturnType(managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(importDecl->inner->resultType)));
3078 for (auto &arg : importDecl->inner->args->get()) {
3079 auto argType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(&arg->getSpec()));
3080 builder.addArgument(arg->getId().get().strVal, argType);
3081 }
3082 builder.setName(funcName);
3083 auto importedFunc = builder.yield();
3084 auto importedIndex =
3085 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getIRFFITable()->addImportedFunction(from, funcName, importedFunc);
3086
3087 // add to extern table
3088 irModule->externTable.put_create(
3089 funcName,
3090 managedPtr(
3091 IRExternEntry{IRExternEntry::externType::importedFunction,
3092 funcName,
3093 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getIRFFITable()->importedLibraries.getIndex(from),
3094 importedIndex}));
3095
3096 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
3097 }
3098
3099 void visitor::tryCastTo(const std::shared_ptr<IRValueType> &toType) {
3100 auto rhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
3101 if (rhs->isForeignBasicType()) {
3102 rhs = managedPtr(rhs->getNormalizedForeignBasicType());
3103 }
3104
3105 if (*rhs == *toType) {
3106 return;
3107 } else if (rhs->isBasicType() && toType->isBasicType() && !rhs->isArrayType() && !toType->isArrayType()) {
3108 emitBasicCastTo(toType);
3109 } else if (rhs->type == IRValueType::valueType::pointerObject) {
3110 // no cast needed for pointer type
3111 return;
3112 } else if (toType->type == IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject) {
3113 // check implemented interfaces
3114 try {
3115 auto implName = getInterfaceImplName({toType->typeAffiliateModule, toType->typeIndex}, rhs);
3116 auto implIndex = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(rhs->typeAffiliateModule)->interfaceImplementationTable.getIndex(implName);
3117 // construct interface object
3118 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().newInterfaceOp(toType->typeIndex, toType->typeAffiliateModule != currentModuleIndex, toType->typeAffiliateModule);
3119 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().constructInterfaceImplOp(implIndex, rhs->typeAffiliateModule != currentModuleIndex, rhs->typeAffiliateModule);
3120 } catch (std::out_of_range &e) {
3121 panic(moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().line, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().column, "Cannot cast type " + yoi::wstring2string((rhs->to_string())) + " to interface " + yoi::wstring2string((toType->to_string())) + ": no implementation found.");
3122 }
3123 } else if (toType->type == IRValueType::valueType::structObject) {
3124 // check whether owns the constructor
3125 auto structType = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(toType->typeAffiliateModule)->structTable[toType->typeIndex];
3126 auto result = resolveOverloadExtern(structType->name + L"::constructor", {rhs}, toType->typeAffiliateModule, structType);
3127 if (result.found()) {
3128 // TODO: Call invoke_dangling to handle the post-this stack structure
3129 panic(moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().line, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().column, "Cannot cast type " + yoi::wstring2string((rhs->to_string())) + " to " + yoi::wstring2string((toType->to_string())) + ": not implemented yet.");
3130 } else {
3131 panic(moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().line, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().column, "Cannot cast type " + yoi::wstring2string((rhs->to_string())) + " to " + yoi::wstring2string((toType->to_string())) + ": no viable conversion found.");
3132 }
3133 } else {
3134 panic(moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().line, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().column, "Cannot cast type " + yoi::wstring2string((rhs->to_string())) + " to " + yoi::wstring2string((toType->to_string())) + ": no viable conversion found.");
3135 }
3136 }
3137
3138 bool visitor::canCastTo(const std::shared_ptr<IRValueType> &fromType, const std::shared_ptr<IRValueType> &toType) {
3139 auto rhs = fromType;
3140 if (fromType->isForeignBasicType()) {
3141 rhs = managedPtr(rhs->getNormalizedForeignBasicType());
3142 }
3143 if (*rhs == *toType) {
3144 return true;
3145 } else if (rhs->isBasicType() && toType->isBasicType() && !rhs->isArrayType() && !toType->isArrayType()) {
3146 return true;
3147 } else if (rhs->type == IRValueType::valueType::pointerObject) {
3148 // no cast needed for pointer type
3149 return true;
3150 } else if (toType->type == IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject) {
3151 // check implemented interfaces
3152 try {
3153 auto implName = getInterfaceImplName({toType->typeAffiliateModule, toType->typeIndex}, rhs);
3154 auto implIndex = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(rhs->typeAffiliateModule)->interfaceImplementationTable.getIndex(implName);
3155 return true;
3156 } catch (std::out_of_range &e) {
3157 return false;
3158 }
3159 } else if (toType->type == IRValueType::valueType::structObject) {
3160 // check whether owns the constructor
3161 auto structType = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(toType->typeAffiliateModule)->structTable[toType->typeIndex];
3162 auto result = resolveOverloadExtern(structType->name + L"::constructor", {rhs}, toType->typeAffiliateModule, structType);
3163 return result.found();
3164 } else {
3165 return false;
3166 }
3167 }
3168
3169 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::typeIdExpression *typeIdExpression) {
3170 if (typeIdExpression->type) {
3171 auto parsedType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(typeIdExpression->type));
3172 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().typeIdOp(parsedType);
3173 } else {
3174 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().saveState();
3175 visit(typeIdExpression->expr);
3176 auto rhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
3177 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().restoreState();
3178 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().typeIdOp(rhs);
3179 }
3180 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
3181 }
3182
3183 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::dynCastExpression *dynCastExpression) {
3184 visit(dynCastExpression->expr);
3185 auto rhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
3186 auto toType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(dynCastExpression->type));
3187 yoi_assert(rhs->type == IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject, dynCastExpression->expr->getLine(), dynCastExpression->expr->getColumn(), "dynamic cast can only be applied to interface objects to struct objects.");
3188
3189 auto &impls = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(rhs->typeAffiliateModule)->interfaceTable[rhs->typeIndex]->implementations;
3190
3191 if (auto it = std::find(impls.begin(), impls.end(), std::make_tuple(toType->type, toType->typeAffiliateModule, toType->typeIndex)); it != impls.end())
3192 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().dynCastOp(toType);
3193 else
3194 panic(dynCastExpression->getLine(), dynCastExpression->getColumn(), "Cannot cast type " + yoi::wstring2string((rhs->to_string())) + " to " + yoi::wstring2string((toType->to_string())) + ": no implementation found.");
3195
3196 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
3197 }

3199 yoi::indexT visitor::generateNullInterfaceImplementation(const std::shared_ptr<IRValueType> &structType) {
3200 auto nullInterface = std::make_pair(HOSHI_COMPILER_CTX_GLOB_ID_CONST, 0);
3201 auto nullImplName = getInterfaceImplName(nullInterface, structType);
3202 try {
3203 return moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(structType->typeAffiliateModule)->interfaceImplementationTable.getIndex(nullImplName);
3204 } catch (std::out_of_range &e) {
3205 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(HOSHI_COMPILER_CTX_GLOB_ID_CONST)->interfaceTable[0]->implementations.emplace_back(
3206 structType->type, structType->typeAffiliateModule, structType->typeIndex);
3207 auto nullImpl = managedPtr(IRInterfaceImplementationDefinition{nullImplName, {structType->type, structType->typeAffiliateModule, structType->typeIndex}, 0, {}, {}});
3208 return moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(structType->typeAffiliateModule)->interfaceImplementationTable.put_create(nullImplName, nullImpl);
3209 }
3210 }
3211
3212 yoi::vec<IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs> visitor::getFunctionAttributes(const yoi::vec<lexer::token> &attrs) {
3213 yoi::vec<IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs> res;
3214 for (auto &attr : attrs) {
3215 switch (attr.kind) {
3216 case lexer::token::tokenKind::kAlwaysInline:
3217 res.push_back(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::AlwaysInline);
3218 break;
3219 case lexer::token::tokenKind::kNoFFI:
3220 res.push_back(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::NoFFI);
3221 break;
3222 case lexer::token::tokenKind::kStatic:
3223 res.push_back(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Static);
3224 break;
3225 default:
3226 break;
3227 }
3228 }
3229 return std::move(res);
3230 }
3231
3232 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::newExpression *newExpression) {
3233 auto baseType = parseTypeSpec(newExpression->type);
3234 generateNullInterfaceImplementation(managedPtr(baseType.getDynamicArrayType()));
3235 for (auto &i : newExpression->args->get()) {
3236 visit(i);
3237 tryCastTo(managedPtr(baseType));
3238 }
3239 visit(newExpression->length->expr);
3240 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().newDynamicArrayOp(managedPtr(baseType), newExpression->args->get().size());
3241 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
3242 }
