3244 yoi::indexT visitor::isModuleName(identifier *it, yoi::indexT currentModule) const {
3245 std::shared_ptr<yoi::IRModule> target =
3246 currentModule == -1 ? irModule : moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(currentModule);
3247 if (auto x = target->moduleImports.find(it->node.strVal); x != target->moduleImports.end()) {
3248 return x->second;
3249 } else {
3250 return currentModule;
3251 }
3252 }
3253
3254 IRValueType visitor::parseTypeSpec(yoi::externModuleAccessExpression *emaExpression) {
3255 auto it = emaExpression->getTerms().begin();
3256 yoi::indexT targetModule = -1, lastModule = -1;
3257 while (it + 1 != emaExpression->getTerms().end() && (targetModule = isModuleName((*it)->id, lastModule)) != lastModule) {
3258 it++;
3259 lastModule = targetModule;
3260 }
3261
3262 bool whetherLastTerm = it + 1 == emaExpression->getTerms().end();
3263 if (targetModule == -1 || targetModule == currentModuleIndex)
3264 return parseTypeSpec((*it));
3265 else
3266 return parseTypeSpecExtern((*it), targetModule);
3267 }
3268
3269 bool visitor::OverloadResult::found() const {
3270 return functionIndex != -1;
3271 }
3272
3273 yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> visitor::evaluateArguments(yoi::invocationArguments *args) {
3274 yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> argTypes;
3275 for (auto& arg : args->get()) {
3276 visit(arg);
3277 argTypes.push_back(moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack());
3278 }
3279 return argTypes;
3280 }
3281
3282 visitor::OverloadResult visitor::resolveOverloadExtern(const yoi::wstr &baseName,
3283 const yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> &argTypes,
3284 yoi::indexT targetModule,
3285 const std::shared_ptr<IRStructDefinition> &structContext) {
3286 OverloadResult result;
3287 auto targetedModule = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(targetModule);
3288
3289 // Pass 1: Look for an exact, non-variadic match in the target module.
3290 auto exactMangledName = baseName + getFuncUniqueNameStr(argTypes);
3291 yoi::wstr lookupName = structContext ? structContext->name + L"::" + exactMangledName : exactMangledName;
3292
3293 if (targetedModule->functionTable.contains(lookupName)) {
3294 result.functionIndex = targetedModule->functionTable.getIndex(lookupName);
3295 result.function = targetedModule->functionTable[result.functionIndex];
3296 // if (result.function->isVariadic) {
3297 if (std::find(result.function->attrs.begin(),
3298 result.function->attrs.end(),
3299 IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Variadic) != result.function->attrs.end()) {
3300 result.isVariadic = true;
3301 result.fixedArgCount = result.function->argumentTypes.size() - 1;
3302 result.variadicElementType = managedPtr(result.function->argumentTypes.back()->getElementType());
3303 }
3304 return result;
3305 }
3306
3307 // Pass 2: Look for a compatible variadic match in the target module.
3308 auto findVariadicMatch = [&](const yoi::wstr &funcKey, bool skipFirstParam = false) {
3309 auto func = targetedModule->functionTable[funcKey];
3310 if (std::find(func->attrs.begin(), func->attrs.end(), IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Variadic) !=
3311 func->attrs.end()) {
3312 const auto &paramTypes = func->argumentTypes;
3313 size_t fixedParamCount = paramTypes.size() - 1 - (skipFirstParam && paramTypes.size() > 1 ? 1 : 0);
3314 if (argTypes.size() >= fixedParamCount) {
3315 bool fixedMatch = true;
3316 for (size_t i = skipFirstParam ? 1 : 0; i < fixedParamCount; ++i) {
3317 if (*paramTypes[i] != *argTypes[i]) {
3318 fixedMatch = false;
3319 break;
3320 }
3321 }
3322 if (fixedMatch) {
3323 result.functionIndex = targetedModule->functionTable.getIndex(funcKey);
3324 result.isVariadic = true;
3325 result.fixedArgCount = fixedParamCount;
3326 result.variadicElementType = managedPtr(paramTypes.back()->getElementType());
3327 result.function = func;
3328 return true;
3329 }
3330 }
3331 }
3332 return false;
3333 };
3334
3335 yoi::wstr prefix = structContext ? structContext->name + L"::" + baseName : baseName;
3336 for (const auto it : targetedModule->functionOverloadIndexies[prefix]) {
3337 const auto &key = targetedModule->functionTable.getKey(it);
3338 if (key.starts_with(prefix)) {
3339 if (findVariadicMatch(key, structContext != nullptr))
3340 return result;
3341 }
3342 }
3343
3344 if (!structContext && targetedModule->funcTemplateAsts.contains(baseName)) {
3345 try {
3346 auto astNode = targetedModule->funcTemplateAsts.at(baseName);
3347 auto templateArgs = getTemplateArgs(astNode->id->getArg());
3348
3349 yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> deducedArgs(templateArgs.size());
3350
3351 for (yoi::indexT i = 0; i < argTypes.size(); i++) {
3352 if (i < templateArgs.size() &&
3353 templateArgs[i].templateType->type == IRValueType::valueType::incompleteTemplateType) {
3354 auto &srcTypeToPlace = argTypes[i];
3355 auto incompleteTypeIndex = templateArgs[i].templateType->typeIndex;
3356 if (deducedArgs[incompleteTypeIndex] && *deducedArgs[incompleteTypeIndex] != *srcTypeToPlace) {
3357 throw std::runtime_error("Template argument type mismatch during deduction.");
3358 }
3359 deducedArgs[incompleteTypeIndex] = srcTypeToPlace;
3360 }
3361 }
3362 for (yoi::indexT i = 0; i < deducedArgs.size(); i++) {
3363 if (deducedArgs[i] == nullptr) {
3364 throw std::runtime_error("Cannot deduce all template arguments for: " + yoi::wstring2string(baseName));
3365 }
3366 }
3367
3368 auto specializedFuncIndex = specializeFunctionTemplate(astNode, deducedArgs, targetModule);
3369 result.functionIndex = specializedFuncIndex;
3370 result.function = targetedModule->functionTable[specializedFuncIndex];
3371
3372 // The newly specialized function might itself be variadic
3373 if(std::find(result.function->attrs.begin(), result.function->attrs.end(), IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Variadic) != result.function->attrs.end()) {
3374 result.isVariadic = true;
3375 result.fixedArgCount = result.function->argumentTypes.size() - 1;
3376 result.variadicElementType = managedPtr(result.function->argumentTypes.back()->getElementType());
3377 }
3378 return result;
3379 } catch (const std::exception&) {
3380 result.functionIndex = -1;
3381 }
3382 }
3383
3384 return result; // Not found
3385 }
3386
3387 bool visitor::handleInvocationExtern(const yoi::wstr &baseName,
3388 yoi::invocationArguments *args,
3389 yoi::indexT targetModule,
3390 const std::shared_ptr<IRValueType> &structContext, bool noThisCall) {
3391 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().saveState();
3392 auto argTypes = evaluateArguments(args);
3393 OverloadResult overload;
3394 if (structContext && structContext->type == IRValueType::valueType::structObject) {
3395 auto structType = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(structContext->typeAffiliateModule)->structTable[structContext->typeIndex];
3396 overload = resolveOverloadExtern(baseName, argTypes, targetModule, structType);
3397 } else if (structContext && structContext->type == IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject) {
3398 auto interfaceType = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(structContext->typeAffiliateModule)->interfaceTable[structContext->typeIndex];
3399 overload = resolveOverloadInterface(baseName, argTypes, targetModule, interfaceType);
3400 } else {
3401 overload = resolveOverloadExtern(baseName, argTypes, targetModule, nullptr);
3402 }
3403
3404 if (!overload.found()) {
3405 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().restoreState();
3406 return false;
3407 }
3408
3409 auto fullMangledName = overload.function->name;
3410
3411 if (overload.isVariadic) {
3412 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().restoreState();
3413 for (size_t i = 0; i < overload.fixedArgCount; ++i) {
3414 visit(args->get()[i]);
3415 }
3416 auto variadicArgCount = argTypes.size() - overload.fixedArgCount;
3417 if (variadicArgCount > 0) {
3418 for (size_t i = 0; i < variadicArgCount; ++i) {
3419 visit(args->get()[i + overload.fixedArgCount]);
3420 tryCastTo(overload.variadicElementType);
3421 }
3422 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().newArrayOp(overload.variadicElementType,
3423 {static_cast<yoi::indexT>(variadicArgCount)});
3424 } else {
3425 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().newArrayOp(overload.variadicElementType, {0});
3426 }
3427 } else {
3428 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().discardState();
3429 }
3430
3431 size_t finalParamCount = overload.function->argumentTypes.size();
3432 if (structContext && structContext->type == IRValueType::valueType::structObject) {
3433 auto externEntry = getExternEntry(targetModule, fullMangledName);
3434 auto isStaticMethod = std::find(overload.function->attrs.begin(), overload.function->attrs.end(), IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Static) != overload.function->attrs.end();
3435 bool usePureStaticLogic = noThisCall && isStaticMethod;
3436
3437 if (usePureStaticLogic) {
3438 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().invokeOp(externEntry.itemIndex,
3439 finalParamCount,
3440 overload.function->returnType,
3441 true,
3442 externEntry.affiliateModule);
3443 } else {
3444 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().invokeMethodOp(externEntry.itemIndex,
3445 finalParamCount - !isStaticMethod,
3446 overload.function->returnType,
3447 isStaticMethod,
3448 true,
3449 externEntry.affiliateModule);
3450 }
3451 } else if (structContext && structContext->type == IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject) {
3452 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().invokeVirtualOp(overload.functionIndex,
3453 structContext->typeIndex,
3454 finalParamCount,
3455 overload.function->returnType,
3456 true,
3457 structContext->typeAffiliateModule);
3458 } else {
3459 auto externEntry = getExternEntry(targetModule, fullMangledName);
3460 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().invokeOp(externEntry.itemIndex,
3461 finalParamCount,
3462 overload.function->returnType,
3463 true,
3464 externEntry.affiliateModule);
3465 }
3466 return true;
3467 }
3468
3469 yoi::indexT visitor::handleBinaryOperatorOverload(const yoi::wstr &overloadName) {
3470 auto lhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getLhsFromTempVarStack();
3471 auto rhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
3472 bool isResolved = false;
3473
3474 if (lhs->type == IRValueType::valueType::structObject) {
3475 auto resolved = resolveOverloadExtern(overloadName, {lhs, rhs}, lhs->typeAffiliateModule, moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(lhs->typeAffiliateModule)->structTable[lhs->typeIndex]);
3476 if (resolved.found()) {
3477 yoi_assert(resolved.isVariadic == false, 0, 0, "Binary operator overloading with variadic functions is not supported.");
3478 yoi_assert(std::find(resolved.function->attrs.begin(), resolved.function->attrs.end(), IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Static) != resolved.function->attrs.end(), moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().line, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().column, "Binary operator overloading with non-static functions is not supported.");
3479
3480 // same as below
3481 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().invokeMethodOp(
3482 resolved.functionIndex, 1, resolved.function->returnType, false, true, lhs->typeAffiliateModule);
3483 isResolved = true;
3484 }
3485 }
3486 if (!isResolved && rhs->type == IRValueType::valueType::structObject) {
3487 auto resolved = resolveOverloadExtern(overloadName, {lhs, rhs}, rhs->typeAffiliateModule, moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(rhs->typeAffiliateModule)->structTable[rhs->typeIndex]);
3488 if (resolved.found()) {
3489 yoi_assert(resolved.isVariadic == false, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().line, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().column, "Binary operator overloading with variadic functions is not supported.");
3490 yoi_assert(std::find(resolved.function->attrs.begin(), resolved.function->attrs.end(), IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Static) != resolved.function->attrs.end(), moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().line, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().column, "Binary operator overloading with non-static functions is not supported.");
3491
3492 // trick here: since when we set isStatic to true, we need 3 elements on the stack, which this ptr should also be present.
3493 // however, we only have 2 elements on the stack which is lhs and rhs, so, we set isStatic to false here.
3494 // to trick the invoke method op into generating the correct code
3495 // this way, this method would take two elements from the stack and push the result to the stack.
3496 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().invokeMethodOp(
3497 resolved.functionIndex, 1, resolved.function->returnType, false, true, rhs->typeAffiliateModule);
3498 isResolved = true;
3499 }
3500 }
3501 if (!isResolved && lhs->type == IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject) {
3502 const auto& baseName = overloadName;
3503 auto mangledName = getFuncUniqueNameStr({rhs});
3504
3505 try {
3506 auto methodIdx = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()
3507 ->getImportedModule(lhs->typeAffiliateModule)
3508 ->interfaceTable[lhs->typeIndex]
3509 ->methodMap.getIndex(baseName + mangledName);
3510 auto method = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()
3511 ->getImportedModule(lhs->typeAffiliateModule)
3512 ->interfaceTable[lhs->typeIndex]
3513 ->methodMap[methodIdx];
3514 yoi_assert(method->argumentTypes.size() == 1,
3515 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().line,
3516 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().column,
3517 "Argument count does not match");
3518 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().invokeVirtualOp(methodIdx, lhs->typeIndex, 1, method->returnType, true, lhs->typeAffiliateModule);
3519 isResolved = true;
3520 } catch (const std::out_of_range &) {
3521
3522 }
3523 }
3524 yoi_assert(isResolved, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().line, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().column, "Binary operator overloading not found for " + yoi::wstring2string(overloadName));
3525
3526 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
3527 }
3528
3529 yoi::indexT visitor::handleUnaryOperatorOverload(const yoi::wstr &overloadName) {
3530 auto rhs = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
3531 bool isResolved = false;
3532
3533 if (rhs->type == IRValueType::valueType::structObject) {
3534 auto resolved = resolveOverloadExtern(overloadName, {rhs}, rhs->typeAffiliateModule, moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(rhs->typeAffiliateModule)->structTable[rhs->typeIndex]);
3535 if (resolved.found()) {
3536 yoi_assert(resolved.isVariadic == false, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().line, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().column, "Unary operator overloading with variadic functions is not supported.");
3537 yoi_assert(std::find(resolved.function->attrs.begin(), resolved.function->attrs.end(), IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Static) != resolved.function->attrs.end(), moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().line, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().column, "Unary operator overloading with non-static functions is not supported.");
3538 // why isStatic = false? check the comment in handleBinaryOperatorOverload
3539 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().invokeMethodOp(
3540 resolved.functionIndex, 0, resolved.function->returnType, false, true, rhs->typeAffiliateModule);
3541 isResolved = true;
3542 }
3543 }
3544 if (rhs->type == IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject) {
3545 const auto &baseName = overloadName;
3546 auto mangledName = getFuncUniqueNameStr({});
3547
3548 auto methodIdx = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(rhs->typeAffiliateModule)->interfaceTable[rhs->typeIndex]
3549 ->methodMap.getIndex(baseName + mangledName);
3550 auto method = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(rhs->typeAffiliateModule)->interfaceTable[rhs->typeIndex]->methodMap[methodIdx];
3551 yoi_assert(method->argumentTypes.size() == 1,
3552 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().line,
3553 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().column,
3554 "Argument count does not match");
3555 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().invokeVirtualOp(methodIdx, rhs->typeIndex, 0, method->returnType, true, rhs->typeAffiliateModule);
3556 isResolved = true;
3557 }
3558 yoi_assert(isResolved, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().line, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentDebugInfo().column, "Unary operator overloading not found for " + yoi::wstring2string(overloadName));
3559
3560 return moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getCurrentInsertionPoint();
3561 }
3562
3563 yoi::indexT visitor::specializeInterfaceTemplate(const yoi::wstr &templateName,
3564 const yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> &concreteTemplateArgs, yoi::indexT moduleIndex) {
3565 auto targetedModule = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(moduleIndex);
3566 yoi::wstr specializedName = getMangledTemplateName(templateName, concreteTemplateArgs);
3567 if (targetedModule->interfaceTable.contains(specializedName)) {
3568 return targetedModule->interfaceTable.getIndex(specializedName);
3569 }
3570
3571 yoi_assert(targetedModule->templateInterfaceAsts.contains(templateName), 0, 0, "Unknown interface template: " + wstring2string(templateName));
3572
3573 auto interfaceAst = targetedModule->templateInterfaceAsts.at(templateName);
3574
3575 IRTemplateBuilder specializationContext;
3576 yoi_assert(concreteTemplateArgs.size() == interfaceAst->id->arg->get().size(), 0, 0, "Template argument count mismatch for interface " + wstring2string(templateName));
3577 for (yoi::indexT i = 0; i < concreteTemplateArgs.size(); ++i) {
3578 auto paramName = interfaceAst->id->arg->get()[i]->getId().get().strVal;
3579 specializationContext.addTemplateArgument(paramName, concreteTemplateArgs[i]);
3580 }
3581
3582 pushModuleContext(moduleIndex);
3583 moduleContext->pushTemplateBuilder(specializationContext);
3584
3585 IRInterfaceInstanceDefinition::Builder builder;
3586 builder.setName(specializedName);
3587
3588 for (auto &i : interfaceAst->getInner().getInner()) {
3589 bool isVaridic = false;
3590 yoi_assert(i->isMethod(), i->getLine(), i->getColumn(), "Interface member must be a method");
3591 auto methodName = i->getMethod().getName().get().strVal;
3592 auto methodResultType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(i->getMethod().resultType));
3593 yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> argTypes;
3594 IRFunctionDefinition::Builder methodBuilder;
3595 methodBuilder.setDebugInfo({irModule->modulePath, i->getLine(), i->getColumn()});
3596 methodBuilder.setReturnType(methodResultType);
3597 for (auto &arg : i->getMethod().getArgs().get()) {
3598 if (&arg == &i->getMethod().getArgs().get().back() && arg->spec->kind == 3) {
3599 isVaridic = true;
3600 methodBuilder.addAttr(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Variadic);
3601 auto argName = arg->getId().node.strVal;
3602 auto argType = managedPtr(moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getNullInterfaceType()->getDynamicArrayType());
3603 methodBuilder.addArgument(argName, argType);
3604 argTypes.push_back(argType);
3605 break;
3606 }
3607 auto argName = arg->getId().get().strVal;
3608 auto argType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(arg->spec));
3609 methodBuilder.addArgument(argName, argType);
3610 argTypes.push_back(argType);
3611 }
3612 auto uniq = getFuncUniqueNameStr(argTypes);
3613 methodBuilder.setName(L"interface#" + specializedName + L"#" + methodName + uniq);
3614 builder.addMethod(methodName + uniq, methodBuilder.yield());
3615 }
3616
3617 auto specializedInterface = builder.yield();
3618 auto interfaceIndex = irModule->interfaceTable.put_create(specializedName, specializedInterface); // since module context is still in foreign module, no need to change to targetedModule
3619
3620 moduleContext->popTemplateBuilder();
3621 popModuleContext();
3622 return interfaceIndex;
3623 }
3624
3625 void visitor::specializeInterfaceImplementation(yoi::implStmt *implAst,
3626 const std::shared_ptr<IRValueType> &concreteStructType,
3627 const yoi::wstr& specializedStructName,
3628 const yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> &concreteTemplateArgs, yoi::indexT targetModule) {
3629
3630 yoi_assert(implAst->isImplForStmt(), implAst->getLine(), implAst->getColumn(), "Expected 'impl for' AST node for interface implementation specialization.");
3631
3632 auto targetedModule = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(targetModule);
3633
3634 // The active specialization context (from specializeStructTemplate) resolves types like `T` to concrete types.
3635 auto concreteInterfaceType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(implAst->interfaceName));
3636 yoi_assert(concreteInterfaceType->type == IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject, implAst->getLine(), implAst->getColumn(), "Expected an interface type.");
3637
3638 // pushModuleContext(targetModule);
3639
3640 auto interfaceSrcPair = std::make_pair(concreteInterfaceType->typeAffiliateModule, concreteInterfaceType->typeIndex);
3641
3642 auto targetInterface = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(interfaceSrcPair.first)
3643 ->interfaceTable[interfaceSrcPair.second];
3644
3645 targetInterface->implementations.emplace_back(
3646 concreteStructType->type, concreteStructType->typeAffiliateModule, concreteStructType->typeIndex
3647 );
3648
3649 auto implName = getInterfaceImplName(interfaceSrcPair, concreteStructType);
3650 if (irModule->interfaceImplementationTable.contains(implName)) {
3651 return; // Already specialized and created.
3652 }
3653
3654 yoi::indexT implIndex{};
3655 try {
3656 implIndex = targetedModule->interfaceImplementationTable.getIndex(implName);
3657 if (targetedModule->interfaceImplementationTable[implIndex]) {
3658 panic(implAst->getLine(), implAst->getColumn(), "Redefinition of interface implementation: " + yoi::wstring2string(implName));
3659 }
3660 } catch (std::out_of_range &e) {
3661 implIndex = targetedModule->interfaceImplementationTable.put_create(implName, nullptr);
3662 }
3663
3664 if (implAst->inner) {
3665 IRInterfaceImplementationDefinition::Builder builder;
3666 builder.setName(implName);
3667 builder.setImplStructIndex({concreteStructType->type, concreteStructType->typeAffiliateModule, concreteStructType->typeIndex});
3668 builder.setImplInterfaceIndex(interfaceSrcPair.second);
3669
3670 std::map<yoi::wstr, std::pair<yoi::wstr, std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>>> virtualMethodMap;
3671
3672 for (auto &methodNode : implAst->getInner().getInner()) {
3673 yoi_assert(!methodNode->isConstructor(), methodNode->getLine(), methodNode->getColumn(), "Only methods are allowed in interface implementations.");
3674 auto &methodAst = methodNode->getMethod();
3675
3676 IRFunctionDefinition::Builder methodBuilder;
3677 methodBuilder.setDebugInfo({irModule->modulePath, methodAst.getLine(), methodAst.getColumn()});
3678 methodBuilder.attrs = getFunctionAttributes(methodAst.attrs);
3679 methodBuilder.attrs.emplace_back(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Preserve);
3680 methodBuilder.attrs.emplace_back(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::NoRawAndNullOptimization);
3681
3682 yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> specializedArgTypes;
3683
3684 if (std::find(methodBuilder.attrs.begin(), methodBuilder.attrs.end(), IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Static) == methodBuilder.attrs.end()) {
3685 methodBuilder.addArgument(L"this", concreteStructType);
3686 }
3687
3688 for (auto &arg : methodAst.getArgs().get()) {
3689 auto specializedArgType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(arg->spec));
3690 methodBuilder.addArgument(arg->getId().get().strVal, specializedArgType);
3691 specializedArgTypes.push_back(specializedArgType);
3692 }
3693
3694 auto uniq = getFuncUniqueNameStr(specializedArgTypes);
3695 auto baseMethodName = methodAst.getName().get().strVal;
3696
3697 methodBuilder.setReturnType(managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(methodAst.resultType)));
3698 methodBuilder.setName(specializedStructName + L"::" + baseMethodName + uniq);
3699
3700 auto func = methodBuilder.yield();
3701 auto funcIndex = irModule->functionTable.put_create(func->name, func);
3702 irModule->functionOverloadIndexies[specializedStructName + L"::" + baseMethodName].emplace_back(funcIndex);
3703
3704 moduleContext->pushIRBuilder({moduleContext->getCompilerContext(), irModule, func});
3705 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().setDebugInfo({irModule->modulePath, methodAst.getLine(), methodAst.getColumn()});
3706 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock());
3707 visit(methodAst.block, true);
3708 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().yield();
3709 moduleContext->popIRBuilder();
3710 virtualMethodMap[baseMethodName + getFuncUniqueNameStr(specializedArgTypes, true)] = {baseMethodName + uniq, managedPtr(IRValueType{IRValueType::valueType::virtualMethod, currentModuleIndex, funcIndex})};
3711 }
3712 for (auto &method : targetInterface->methodMap) {
3713 yoi_assert(virtualMethodMap.contains(method.first), implAst->getLine(), implAst->getColumn(), "Interface method not found in implementation: " + wstring2string(method.first));
3714 builder.addVirtualMethod(virtualMethodMap[method.first].first, virtualMethodMap[method.first].second);
3715 }
3716
3717 // popModuleContext();
3718
3719 targetedModule->interfaceImplementationTable[implIndex] = builder.yield();
3720 } else {
3721 // forward-declaration
3722 }
3723 }
3724
3725 visitor::OverloadResult
3726 visitor::resolveOverloadInterface(const yoi::wstr &baseName,
3727 const yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> &argTypes,
3728 yoi::indexT targetModule,
3729 const std::shared_ptr<IRInterfaceInstanceDefinition> &interfaceContext) {
3730 OverloadResult result;
3731 auto targetedModule = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(targetModule);
3732
3733 auto exactMangledName = baseName + getFuncUniqueNameStr(argTypes);
3734
3735 if (interfaceContext->methodMap.contains(exactMangledName)) {
3736 result.isVirtual = true;
3737 result.functionIndex = interfaceContext->methodMap.getIndex(exactMangledName);
3738 result.function = interfaceContext->methodMap[result.functionIndex];
3739 if (std::find(result.function->attrs.begin(),
3740 result.function->attrs.end(),
3741 IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Variadic) != result.function->attrs.end()) {
3742 result.isVariadic = true;
3743 result.fixedArgCount = result.function->argumentTypes.size() - 1;
3744 result.variadicElementType = managedPtr(result.function->argumentTypes.back()->getElementType());
3745 }
3746 return result;
3747 }
3748
3749 auto findVariadicMatch = [&](const yoi::wstr &funcKey) {
3750 auto func = interfaceContext->methodMap[funcKey];
3751 if (std::find(func->attrs.begin(), func->attrs.end(), IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Variadic) !=
3752 func->attrs.end()) {
3753 const auto &paramTypes = func->argumentTypes;
3754 size_t fixedParamCount = paramTypes.size() - 1;
3755 if (argTypes.size() >= fixedParamCount) {
3756 bool fixedMatch = true;
3757 for (size_t i = 0; i < fixedParamCount; ++i) {
3758 if (*paramTypes[i] != *argTypes[i]) {
3759 fixedMatch = false;
3760 break;
3761 }
3762 }
3763 if (fixedMatch) {
3764 result.functionIndex = interfaceContext->methodMap.getIndex(funcKey);
3765 result.isVariadic = true;
3766 result.isVirtual = true;
3767 result.fixedArgCount = fixedParamCount;
3768 result.variadicElementType = managedPtr(paramTypes.back()->getElementType());
3769 result.function = func;
3770 return true;
3771 }
3772 }
3773 }
3774 return false;
3775 };
3776
3777 for (const auto it : targetedModule->functionOverloadIndexies[baseName]) {
3778 const auto &key = targetedModule->functionTable.getKey(it);
3779 if (key.starts_with(baseName)) {
3780 if (findVariadicMatch(key))
3781 return result;
3782 }
3783 }
3784
3785 return result; // Not found
3786 }
3787
3788 void visitor::pushModuleContext(yoi::indexT moduleIndex) {
3789 moduleContextStack.emplace(moduleContext, currentModuleIndex);
3790 this->moduleContext = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getModuleContext(moduleIndex);
3791 this->irModule = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(moduleIndex);
3792 currentModuleIndex = moduleIndex;
3793 }
3794
3795 void visitor::popModuleContext() {
3796 this->moduleContext = moduleContextStack.top().first;
3797 currentModuleIndex = moduleContextStack.top().second;
3798 this->irModule = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(currentModuleIndex);
3799 moduleContextStack.pop();
3800 }
3801
3802 bool visitor::handleSubscript(yoi::vec<yoi::subscript *>::iterator &it,
3803 yoi::vec<yoi::subscript *>::iterator end,
3804 bool isStoreOp,
3805 bool isLastTerm) {
3806 auto objectOnStackType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
3807 auto currentTerm = *it;
3808
3809 if (objectOnStackType->isArrayType() || objectOnStackType->isDynamicArrayType()) {
3810 const auto &dimensions = objectOnStackType->dimensions;
3811 yoi::vec<yoi::indexT> strides(dimensions.size());
3812 strides.back() = 1;
3813 for (long long i = static_cast<long long>(dimensions.size()) - 2; i >= 0; --i) {
3814 strides[i] = strides[i + 1] * dimensions[i + 1];
3815 }
3816
3817 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().pushOp(
3818 IR::Opcode::push_unsigned,
3819 {IROperand::operandType::unsignedInt, IROperand::operandValue{static_cast<int64_t>(0)}});
3820
3821 yoi::indexT currentDim = 0;
3822 while (it != end && (*it)->isSubscript()) {
3823 yoi_assert(currentDim < dimensions.size(),
3824 (*it)->getLine(),
3825 (*it)->getColumn(),
3826 "Too many indices for array dimension.");
3827 visit((*it)->expr);
3828 tryCastTo(moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getUnsignedObjectType());
3829 yoi_assert(moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack()->type ==
3830 IRValueType::valueType::unsignedObject,
3831 (*it)->getLine(),
3832 (*it)->getColumn(),
3833 "Array subscript index must be an integer or unsigned integer.");
3834 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().pushOp(IR::Opcode::push_unsigned,
3835 {IROperand::operandType::unsignedInt, strides[currentDim]});
3836 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().arithmeticOp(IR::Opcode::mul);
3837 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().arithmeticOp(IR::Opcode::add);
3838 it++;
3839 currentDim++;
3840 }
3841
3842 yoi_assert(currentDim == dimensions.size() || (isStoreOp && isLastTerm),
3843 currentTerm->getLine(),
3844 currentTerm->getColumn(),
3845 "Partial array access is not a loadable value. Not enough indices provided.");
3846
3847 if (isStoreOp && isLastTerm) {
3848 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().storeOp(IR::Opcode::store_element, {});
3849 } else {
3850 auto elementType = managedPtr(objectOnStackType->getElementType());
3851 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().loadOp(IR::Opcode::load_element, {}, elementType);
3852 }
3853 return true;
3854 } else {
3855 if (isLastTerm && isStoreOp) {
3856 // current stack: [..., value, array, index]
3857 auto value = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getLhsFromTempVarStack();
3858 auto array = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
3859 visit(currentTerm->expr);
3860 auto index = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
3861
3862 OverloadResult overload;
3863 if (array->type == IRValueType::valueType::structObject)
3864 overload = resolveOverloadExtern(L"operator[]",
3865 {value, array, index},
3866 array->typeAffiliateModule,
3867 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()
3868 ->getImportedModule(array->typeAffiliateModule)
3869 ->structTable[array->typeIndex]);
3870 /*else if(array->type == IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject)
3871 overload = resolveOverloadInterface(L"operator[]", {value, array, index},
3872 array->typeAffiliateModule,
3873 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(array->typeAffiliateModule)->interfaceTable[array->typeIndex]);*/
3874
3875 yoi_assert(overload.found(),
3876 currentTerm->getLine(),
3877 currentTerm->getColumn(),
3878 "No matching overload found for operator[].");
3879 yoi_assert(!overload.isVariadic,
3880 currentTerm->getLine(),
3881 currentTerm->getColumn(),
3882 "Variadic operator[] overloading is not supported.");
3883
3884 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().invokeMethodOp(
3885 overload.functionIndex, 2, overload.function->returnType, false, true, array->typeAffiliateModule);
3886
3887 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().popOp();
3888 } else {
3889 visit(currentTerm->expr);
3890 handleBinaryOperatorOverload(L"operator[]");
3891 }
3892 }
3893 return false;
3894 }

3896 IRValueType visitor::parseTypeSpec(yoi::funcTypeSpec *typeSpec) {
3897 vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> argTypes;
3898 for (auto &arg : typeSpec->args->types) {
3899 argTypes.push_back(managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(arg)));
3900 }
3901 auto returnType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(typeSpec->resultType));
3902
3903 return IRValueType{IRValueType::valueType::interfaceObject,
3904 HOSHI_COMPILER_CTX_GLOB_ID_CONST,
3905 createCallableInterface(argTypes, returnType)};
3906 }
3907
3908 yoi::indexT visitor::createCallableInterface(const yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> &parameterTypes,
3909 const std::shared_ptr<IRValueType> &returnType) {
3910 auto callableInterfaceName = L"callable" + getFuncUniqueNameStr(parameterTypes);
3911 callableInterfaceName += getTypeSpecUniqueNameStr(returnType);
3912 if (moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(HOSHI_COMPILER_CTX_GLOB_ID_CONST)->interfaceTable.contains(callableInterfaceName)) {
3913 return moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(HOSHI_COMPILER_CTX_GLOB_ID_CONST)
3914 ->interfaceTable.getIndex(callableInterfaceName);
3915 }
3916
3917 auto interfaceIndex = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()
3918 ->getImportedModule(HOSHI_COMPILER_CTX_GLOB_ID_CONST)
3919 ->interfaceTable.put_create(callableInterfaceName, {});
3920
3921 yoi::vec<std::pair<yoi::wstr, std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>>> argTypes;
3922 for (auto &arg : parameterTypes) {
3923 argTypes.emplace_back(L"arg", arg);
3924 }
3925 IRInterfaceInstanceDefinition::Builder builder;
3926 builder.setName(callableInterfaceName);
3927 builder.addMethod(L"operator()" + getFuncUniqueNameStr(parameterTypes), managedPtr(IRFunctionDefinition{
3928 L"operator()" + getFuncUniqueNameStr(parameterTypes),
3929 argTypes,
3930 returnType,
3931 {},
3932 {},
3933 {}
3934 }));
3935
3936 moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(HOSHI_COMPILER_CTX_GLOB_ID_CONST)->interfaceTable[interfaceIndex] = builder.yield();
3937
3938 return interfaceIndex;
3939 }

3941 yoi::indexT visitor::createLambdaUnnamedStruct(yoi::lambdaExpr *lambdaExpr) {
3942 auto structName = L"lambda" + std::to_wstring(lambdaExpr->getLine()) + L"_" + std::to_wstring(lambdaExpr->getColumn());
3943 auto structIndex = irModule->structTable.put_create(structName, nullptr);
3944
3945 auto structType = managedPtr(IRValueType{IRValueType::valueType::structObject, currentModuleIndex, structIndex});
3946
3947 IRStructDefinition::Builder builder;
3948 builder.setName(structName);
3949 // add captured variables as fields
3950 IRFunctionDefinition::Builder callableBuilder;
3951 yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> argTypes;
3952
3953 callableBuilder.setDebugInfo({irModule->modulePath, lambdaExpr->getLine(), lambdaExpr->getColumn()});
3954 callableBuilder.attrs.push_back(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Preserve);
3955 callableBuilder.attrs.emplace_back(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::NoRawAndNullOptimization);
3956 callableBuilder.addArgument(L"this", structType);
3957 for (auto &i : lambdaExpr->args->spec) {
3958 auto argType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(i->spec));
3959 callableBuilder.addArgument(i->id->node.strVal, argType);
3960 argTypes.push_back(argType);
3961 }
3962 auto returnType = managedPtr(parseTypeSpec(lambdaExpr->resultType));
3963 callableBuilder.setReturnType(returnType);
3964 callableBuilder.setName(structName + L"::operator()" + getFuncUniqueNameStr(argTypes));
3965 auto callableFunc = callableBuilder.yield();
3966 auto callableFuncIndex = irModule->functionTable.put_create(callableFunc->name, callableFunc);
3967 irModule->functionOverloadIndexies[structName + L"::operator()"].push_back(callableFuncIndex);
3968 builder.addMethod(L"operator()" + getFuncUniqueNameStr(argTypes), callableFuncIndex);
3969
3970 // add captured variables as fields
3971 // now a trick here, we put new_struct op first, so that we can build the IR without rolling back the builder state
3972 // when we add captured variables as fields
3973 argTypes.clear();
3974 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().newStructOp(structIndex);
3975 for (auto &i : lambdaExpr->captures) {
3976 visit(i);
3977 auto capturedVar = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
3978 // i guess the IRValueType here is referenceable.
3979 capturedVar->addAttribute(IRValueType::ValueAttr::Nullable);
3980 argTypes.push_back(managedPtr(*capturedVar));
3981 builder.addField(i->node.strVal, managedPtr(*capturedVar));
3982 }
3983 // add the constructor method
3984 IRFunctionDefinition::Builder constructorBuilder;
3985 constructorBuilder.setDebugInfo({irModule->modulePath, lambdaExpr->getLine(), lambdaExpr->getColumn()});
3986 constructorBuilder.addArgument(L"this", structType);
3987 constructorBuilder.addAttr(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::Constructor);
3988 constructorBuilder.addAttr(IRFunctionDefinition::FunctionAttrs::NoRawAndNullOptimization);
3989 for (yoi::indexT i = 0;i < argTypes.size(); ++i) {
3990 constructorBuilder.addArgument(lambdaExpr->captures[i]->node.strVal, argTypes[i]);
3991 }
3992 constructorBuilder.setReturnType(structType);
3993 constructorBuilder.setName(structName + L"::constructor" + getFuncUniqueNameStr(argTypes));
3994 auto constructorFunc = constructorBuilder.yield();
3995 auto constructorFuncIndex = irModule->functionTable.put_create(constructorFunc->name, constructorFunc);
3996 irModule->functionOverloadIndexies[structName + L"::constructor"].push_back(constructorFuncIndex);
3997 builder.addMethod(L"constructor" + getFuncUniqueNameStr(argTypes), constructorFuncIndex);
3998
3999 // now we add the struct to the module
4000 irModule->structTable[structIndex] = builder.yield();
4001
4002 // now we invokes the constructor method to initialize the struct
4003 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().invokeMethodOp(constructorFuncIndex, argTypes.size(), structType, false, true, currentModuleIndex);
4004
4005 // finally, we generate the implementations for both operator() and constructor
4006 moduleContext->pushIRBuilder(IRBuilder{
4007 moduleContext->getCompilerContext(),
4008 irModule,
4009 irModule->functionTable[callableFuncIndex]
4010 });
4011 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().setDebugInfo({irModule->modulePath, lambdaExpr->getLine(), lambdaExpr->getColumn()});
4012 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock());
4013 visit(lambdaExpr->block, true);
4014 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().yield();
4015 moduleContext->popIRBuilder();
4016
4017 moduleContext->pushIRBuilder(IRBuilder{
4018 moduleContext->getCompilerContext(),
4019 irModule,
4020 irModule->functionTable[constructorFuncIndex]
4021 });
4022 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().setDebugInfo({irModule->modulePath, lambdaExpr->getLine(), lambdaExpr->getColumn()});
4023 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().switchCodeBlock(moduleContext->getIRBuilder().createCodeBlock());
4024 for (yoi::indexT i = 0; i < lambdaExpr->captures.size(); ++i) {
4025 // we store our parameters into the fields of the struct
4026 // load local in accordance with the order of arguments
4027 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().loadOp(IR::Opcode::load_local, {IROperand::operandType::localVar, i + 1}, argTypes[i]); // take advantages of the argTypes which we haven't clear it yet.
4028 // store the parameter into the field
4029 // now we load the this pointer, and store the parameter into the field
4030 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().loadOp(IR::Opcode::load_local, {IROperand::operandType::localVar, IROperand::operandValue{static_cast<yoi::indexT>(0)}}, structType);
4031 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().storeMemberOp({IROperand::operandType::index, i});
4032 }
4033 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().loadOp(IR::Opcode::load_local, {IROperand::operandType::localVar, IROperand::operandValue{static_cast<yoi::indexT>(0)}}, structType);
4034 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().retOp();
4035 moduleContext->getIRBuilder().yield();
4036 moduleContext->popIRBuilder();
4037
4038 return structIndex;
4039 }
4040
4041 std::pair<yoi::indexT, std::pair<yoi::indexT, yoi::indexT>> visitor::createCallableImplementationForLambda(const std::shared_ptr<IRStructDefinition> &lambda,
4042 yoi::indexT lambdaStructIndex,
4043 yoi::indexT moduleIndex) {
4044 yoi::wstr callableName;
4045 yoi::indexT callableIndex;
4046 yoi::vec<std::shared_ptr<IRValueType>> argTypes;
4047 for (auto &[key, value] : lambda->nameIndexMap) {
4048 if (key.starts_with(L"operator()")) {
4049 callableName = key;
4050 callableIndex = value.index;
4051 break;
4052 }
4053 }
4054 auto callableFunc = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getImportedModule(moduleIndex)->functionTable[callableIndex];
4055 // ignore the first argument, which is the this pointer
4056 for (yoi::indexT i = 1; i < callableFunc->argumentTypes.size(); ++i) {
4057 argTypes.push_back(callableFunc->argumentTypes[i]);
4058 }
4059 auto returnType = callableFunc->returnType;
4060
4061 auto interfaceSrc = std::pair{HOSHI_COMPILER_CTX_GLOB_ID_CONST, createCallableInterface(argTypes, returnType)};
4062 auto interfaceImpl = getInterfaceImplName(interfaceSrc, moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack());
4063
4064
4065 IRInterfaceImplementationDefinition::Builder builder;
4066 builder.setImplInterfaceIndex(interfaceSrc.second)
4067 .setImplStructIndex({IRValueType::valueType::structObject, moduleIndex, lambdaStructIndex})
4068 .setName(interfaceImpl)
4069 .addVirtualMethod(callableName, managedPtr(IRValueType{
4070 IRValueType::valueType::virtualMethod,
4071 moduleIndex,
4072 callableIndex
4073 }));
4074 auto implIndex = irModule->interfaceImplementationTable.put_create(interfaceImpl, builder.yield());
4075
4076 return {implIndex, interfaceSrc};
4077 }

4079 yoi::indexT visitor::visit(yoi::callableExpression *callableExpression) {
4080 visit(callableExpression->expr);
4081 auto callableType = moduleContext->getIRBuilder().getRhsFromTempVarStack();
4082 // unfinished
4083 return -1;
4084 }

4086 bool visitor::checkMarcoSatisfaction(yoi::marcoDescriptor *desc) {
4087 if (!desc)
4088 return true;
4089 bool satisfied = true;
4090
4091 auto convertToSameType = [](lexer::token &lhs, lexer::token &rhs) -> std::pair<lexer::token, lexer::token> {
4092 switch (lhs.kind) {
4093 case lexer::token::tokenKind::integer:
4094 switch (rhs.kind) {
4095 case lexer::token::tokenKind::integer: return {lhs, rhs};
4096 case lexer::token::tokenKind::decimal: return {lexer::token{0, 0, lexer::token::tokenKind::decimal, static_cast<double>(lhs.basicVal.vDeci)}, rhs};
4097 default: panic(lhs.line, lhs.col, "Cannot convert marco value to comparable type.");
4098 }
4099 case lexer::token::tokenKind::decimal:
4100 switch (rhs.kind) {
4101 case lexer::token::tokenKind::integer: return {lhs, lexer::token{0, 0, lexer::token::tokenKind::decimal, static_cast<double>(rhs.basicVal.vUint)}};
4102 case lexer::token::tokenKind::decimal: return {lhs, rhs};
4103 default: panic(lhs.line, lhs.col, "Cannot convert marco value to comparable type.");
4104 }
4105 case lexer::token::tokenKind::string:
4106 switch (rhs.kind) {
4107 case lexer::token::tokenKind::string: return {lhs, rhs};
4108 case lexer::token::tokenKind::boolean: return {lexer::token{0, 0, lexer::token::tokenKind::integer, static_cast<uint64_t>(lhs.strVal == rhs.strVal)}, rhs};
4109 default: panic(lhs.line, lhs.col, "Cannot convert marco value to comparable type.");
4110 }
4111 case lexer::token::tokenKind::boolean:
4112 switch (rhs.kind) {
4113 case lexer::token::tokenKind::string: return {lexer::token{0, 0, lexer::token::tokenKind::integer, static_cast<uint64_t>(lhs.strVal == rhs.strVal)}, rhs};
4114 case lexer::token::tokenKind::boolean: return {lhs, rhs};
4115 default: panic(lhs.line, lhs.col, "Cannot convert marco value to comparable type.");
4116 }
4117 default:;
4118 }
4119 return {lhs, rhs};
4120 };
4121 auto compare = [&](lexer::token &lhs, lexer::token &rhs, lexer::token::tokenKind op) {
4122 auto [lhsTok, rhsTok] = convertToSameType(lhs, rhs);
4123 switch (op) {
4124 case lexer::token::tokenKind::equal: return lhsTok.basicVal.vUint == rhsTok.basicVal.vUint && lhsTok.strVal == rhsTok.strVal;
4125 case lexer::token::tokenKind::notEqual: return lhsTok.basicVal.vUint != rhsTok.basicVal.vUint || lhsTok.strVal != rhsTok.strVal;
4126 case lexer::token::tokenKind::greaterThan:
4127 switch (lhsTok.kind) {
4128 case lexer::token::tokenKind::integer: return lhsTok.basicVal.vUint > rhsTok.basicVal.vUint;
4129 case lexer::token::tokenKind::decimal: return lhsTok.basicVal.vDeci > rhsTok.basicVal.vDeci;
4130 default: panic(lhs.line, lhs.col, "Cannot compare marco value.");
4131 }
4132 case lexer::token::tokenKind::greaterEqual:
4133 switch (lhsTok.kind) {
4134 case lexer::token::tokenKind::integer: return lhsTok.basicVal.vUint >= rhsTok.basicVal.vUint;
4135 case lexer::token::tokenKind::decimal: return lhsTok.basicVal.vDeci >= rhsTok.basicVal.vDeci;
4136 default: panic(lhs.line, lhs.col, "Cannot compare marco value.");
4137 }
4138 case lexer::token::tokenKind::lessThan:
4139 switch (lhsTok.kind) {
4140 case lexer::token::tokenKind::integer: return lhsTok.basicVal.vUint < rhsTok.basicVal.vUint;
4141 case lexer::token::tokenKind::decimal: return lhsTok.basicVal.vDeci < rhsTok.basicVal.vDeci;
4142 default: panic(lhs.line, lhs.col, "Cannot compare marco value.");
4143 }
4144 case lexer::token::tokenKind::lessEqual:
4145 switch (lhsTok.kind) {
4146 case lexer::token::tokenKind::integer: return lhsTok.basicVal.vUint <= rhsTok.basicVal.vUint;
4147 case lexer::token::tokenKind::decimal: return lhsTok.basicVal.vDeci <= rhsTok.basicVal.vDeci;
4148 default: panic(lhs.line, lhs.col, "Cannot compare marco value.");
4149 }
4150 default:;
4151 }
4152 return false;
4153 };
4154
4155 auto &marcos = moduleContext->getCompilerContext()->getBuildConfig()->marcos;
4156 for (auto &i : desc->pairs) {
4157 bool currentSatisfied = false;
4158 auto &marco = i->identifier.strVal;
4159 yoi_assert(marcos.contains(marco), desc->getLine(), desc->getColumn(), "Undefined marco: " + yoi::wstring2string(marco));
4160 auto &value = marcos[marco];
4161 auto tok = lexer(std::wstringstream(value)).scan();
4162 tok.kind = tok.kind == lexer::token::tokenKind::identifier ? lexer::token::tokenKind::string : tok.kind;
4163
4164 auto &targetValue = i->rhs;
4165 switch (i->constraint.kind) {
4166 case lexer::token::tokenKind::equal: {
4167 currentSatisfied = tok.basicVal.vUint == targetValue.basicVal.vUint && tok.strVal == targetValue.strVal;
4168 break;
4169 }
4170 case lexer::token::tokenKind::notEqual: {
4171 currentSatisfied = tok.basicVal.vUint != targetValue.basicVal.vUint || tok.strVal != targetValue.strVal;
4172 break;
4173 }
4174 case lexer::token::tokenKind::greaterThan:
4175 case lexer::token::tokenKind::greaterEqual:
4176 case lexer::token::tokenKind::lessThan:
4177 case lexer::token::tokenKind::lessEqual: {
4178 currentSatisfied = compare(tok, targetValue, i->constraint.kind);
4179 break;
4180 }
4181 default: {
4182 panic(desc->getLine(), desc->getColumn(), "Unsupported marco constraint kind: " + std::string{magic_enum::enum_name(i->constraint.kind)});
4183 break;
4184 }
4185 }
4186 if (!currentSatisfied) {
4187 satisfied = false;
4188 break;
4189 }
4190 }
4191 return satisfied;
4192 }

4194 void visitor::visit(yoi::typeAliasStmt *typeAlias) {
4195 if (typeAlias->lhs->hasDefTemplateArg()) {
4196 panic(typeAlias->getLine(), typeAlias->getColumn(), "type alias template not implemented yet");
4197 } else {
4198 auto aliasName = typeAlias->lhs->getId().node.strVal;
4199 auto rhs = parseTypeSpec(typeAlias->rhs);
4200 if (irModule->typeAliases.contains(aliasName)) {
4201 panic(typeAlias->getLine(), typeAlias->getColumn(), "Redefinition of type alias: " + yoi::wstring2string(aliasName));
4202 } else {
4203 irModule->typeAliases[aliasName] = rhs;
4204 }
4205 }
4206 }
